 function bkGive(S, j, mode) { const b = S.B, e = S.E[j]; b.held = j; b.mode = mode || 'hand'; S.own = j; S.coolJ = -1; for (const q of S.E) q.hold = false; e.hold = b.mode !== 'drib'; S.planT = S.t + .5 + S.R() * .6; S.plan = null; if (e.team >= 0 && S.n === 2 || S.n === 5) { if (e.team !== S.off && e.team >= 0) { S.off = e.team; S.chg = S.t; S.need = S.n === 2 ?  function bkLaunch(S, j, tx, ty, tz, apex, why) { const b = S.B, e = S.E[j]; b.held = -1; e.hold = false; const dx = (tx - b.x) / 10, dy = (ty - b.y) / 10, D = hyp(dx, dy), H = Math.max(apex, b.z + .2, tz + .2), vz = Math.sqrt(2 * G * (H - b.z)), T = vz / G + Math.sqrt(2 * Math.max(0, H - tz) / G);
  b.vx = dx / T * 10; b.vy = dy / T * 10; b.vz = vz; S.coolJ = j; S.coolT = S.t + .3; S.own = -1; S.last = j; S.lastT = e.team; if (why) S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: why, j }); return T; }
 function bkPass(S, j, r) { const b = S.B, e = S.E[j], q = S.E[r], d = hyp(q.x - e.x, q.y - e.y), T0 = d / 95, lp = [q.x + q.vx * T0 * .6 + Math.cos(Math.atan2(e.y - q.y, e.x - q.x)) * 2.5, q.y + q.vy * T0 * .6 + Math.sin(Math.atan2(e.y - q.y, e.x - q.x)) * 2.5];
  { const p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 2, e.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; } const dd = hyp(lp[0] - b.x, lp[1] - b.y) / 10, vh = 9, T = Math.max(.2, dd / vh); b.held = -1; e.hold = false;

 function bkCheck(S, a, r) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, th = E[a], q = E[r], u = S.t; th.hold = false; b.held = -1; b.mode = 'hand'; const p = ballOn(th.look, th.x, th.y, th.h, 2, th.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2];

 function bkThink(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, u = S.t, n = S.n, rf = E[S.rf];
  if (S.st === 'in' || S.st === 'out') return;
  const H = hoopOf(S, S.off), Hd = hoopOf(S, 1 - S.off);
  
  rf.tx = cl(b.x - (n === 5 ? (H.s < 0 ? 40 : -40) : 30), n === 5 ? BK.x0 + 20 : 220, BK.x1 - 18); rf.ty = BK.y1 + 7; rf.spd = 4; rf.face = [b.x, b.y];
  if (S.st === 'jump' || S.st === 'check' || S.st === 'inb') return;
  const offE = E.filter(e => e.team === S.off), defE = E.filter(e => e.team === 1 - S.off), Hs = n === 5 ? [[0, 7.3], [-52, 6.8], [52, 6.8], [-84, 6.5], [64, 2.4]] : [[0, 7.3], [S.side || -55, 6.6]];
  if (S.st === 'live' && (!S.spT || u > S.spT)) { S.spT = u + 3 + S.R() * 4; S.side = S.R() < .5 ? -55 : 55; S.rot = (S.rot || 0) + (S.R() < .4 ? 1 : 0); }
  offE.forEach((e, k) => { const q = Hs[(k + (S.rot || 0)) % Hs.length], p = spotB(H, q[0], q[1]); if (S.own !== e.j) { e.tx = p[0]; e.ty = p[1]; e.spd = hyp(p[0] - e.x, p[1] - e.y) > 50 ? 5.5 : 3; e.face = [b.x, b.y]; } });
  if (S.st === 'bring' || S.st === 'clear') { const h = E[S.own >= 0 ? S.own : S.last]; if (h && S.own === h.j) { const p = spotB(H, 0, 7.6); h.tx = p[0]; h.ty = p[1]; h.spd = 4.6; if (hyp(h.x - p[0], h.y - p[1]) < 12) S.st = 'live'; } }
  defE.forEach((e, k) => { const m = offE[k] || offE[0], dd = hyp(H.rx - m.x, BK.cy - m.y), f = dd > 30 ? .26 : .12; e.tx = m.x + (H.rx - m.x) * f; e.ty = m.y + (BK.cy - m.y) * f; e.spd = hyp(e.tx - e.x, e.ty - e.y) > 40 ? 5.8 : 4; e.face = [m.x, m.y]; });
  
  if (b.held < 0) { const lp = bkLand(S); for (let tm = 0; tm < 2; tm++) { const T = E.filter(e => e.team === tm).map(e => [hyp(e.x - lp[0], e.y - lp[1]), e]).sort((a, c) => a[0] - c[0]); T.slice(0, n === 5 ? 2 : 1).forEach((q, k) => { const e = q[1]; if (S.passTo === e.j && u - S.passT < 2) { e.tx = S.passPt[0]; e.ty = S.passPt[1]; } else { e.tx = lp[0] + (k ? 9 : 0) * (tm ? 1 : -1); e.ty = lp[1] + (k ? 6 : 0); } e.spd = e.top; e.face = [b.x, b.y]; }); } return; }
  if (S.own < 0) return; const h = E[S.own]; if (h.team !== S.off) return;
  if (S.st !== 'live') return;
  
  const dr = hyp(H.rx - h.x, BK.cy - h.y), opp = defE.reduce((m, e) => Math.min(m, hyp(e.x - h.x, e.y - h.y)), 1e9);
  if (!S.plan && u > S.planT) { const R = S.R; if (dr < 26) S.plan = { k: 'shoot' }; else if (dr < 74 && opp > 12 && R() < .4) S.plan = { k: 'shoot' }; else if (R() < .22 && dr < 110) S.plan = { k: 'drive', p: [H.rx + H.s * 15, BK.cy + (R() - .5) * 16] };
   else if (R() < .65) { let best = null, bs = -1e9; offE.forEach(e => { if (e === h) return; const o = defE.reduce((m, f) => Math.min(m, hyp(f.x - e.x, f.y - e.y)), 1e9), lane = defE.reduce((m, f) => Math.min(m, segD(f.x, f.y, h.x, h.y, e.x, e.y)), 1e9); const s = o / 10 + Math.min(lane, 12) / 4 + R() * 2 - (e.j === S.lastPass ? 2 : 0); if (s > bs) { bs = s; best = e; } }); S.plan = best ? { k: 'pass', r: best.j } : { k: 'drib', p: spotB(H, (R() - .5) * 120, 6 + R() * 1.5) }; }
   else S.plan = { k: 'drib', p: spotB(H, (R() - .5) * 130, 5.5 + R() * 2) }; }
  const P = S.plan; if (P && (P.k === 'drive' || P.k === 'drib')) { h.tx = P.p[0]; h.ty = P.p[1]; h.spd = P.k === 'drive' ? 5.6 : 3.8; h.face = [H.rx, BK.cy]; if (b.mode === 'hand') { b.mode = 'drib'; b.vz = -3.2; h.hold = false; } }
  else { h.tx = h.x; h.ty = h.y; h.face = P && P.k === 'pass' ? [E[P.r].x, E[P.r].y] : [H.rx, BK.cy]; } }
 function bkLand(S) { const b = S.B; let x = b.x, y = b.y, z = b.z, vx = b.vx, vy = b.vy, vz = b.vz; for (let k = 0; k < 150; k++) { vz -= G * .02; x += vx * .02; y += vy * .02; z += vz * .02; if (vz < 0 && z < 2.1) break; } return [cl(x, BK.x0 + 4, BK.x1 - 4), cl(y, BK.y0 + 4, BK.y1 - 4)]; }
 function bkBall(S) { const b = S.B, E = S.E;
  if (b.held >= 0) { const e = E[b.held]; b.hid = !e.vis; const ch = Math.cos(e.h), sh = Math.sin(e.h);
   if (b.mode === 'drib') { const sd = 2.4 * e.look.h / 1.8; b.x = e.x + ch * 1.1 - sh * sd; b.y = e.y + sh * 1.1 + ch * sd * .42 + .3; b.vz -= G * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; if (b.z <= .12) { b.z = .12; b.vz = Math.abs(b.vz) * .84; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'bounce' }); } if (b.z >= .46 * e.look.h + .12 && b.vz > 0) { if (S.stopDrib) { b.mode = 'hand'; e.hold = true; S.stopDrib = false; } else b.vz = -(3.1 + hyp(e.vx, e.vy) / 30); } b.roll += 2; return; }
   const p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, b.mode === 'up' ? 4 : 2, e.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; b.vx = b.vy = b.vz = 0; return; }    
  b.hid = false; const px = b.x, py = b.y, pz = b.z; b.vz -= G * DT; b.x += b.vx * DT; b.y += b.vy * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; b.roll += hyp(b.x - px, b.y - py);
  if (b.z <= .12) { b.z = .12; if (b.vz < -.8) { b.vz = -b.vz * .78; b.vx *= .9; b.vy *= .9; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'bounce' }); } else { b.vz = 0; const sp = hyp(b.vx, b.vy); if (sp > 0) { const ns = Math.max(0, sp - 8 * DT); b.vx *= ns / sp; b.vy *= ns / sp; } } }
  for (let hi = 0; hi < 2; hi++) { const H = BK.H[hi];
   
   if (Math.abs(b.y - BK.cy) < 9 + 1.2 && b.z > 2.9 - .12 && b.z < 3.95 + .12) { const s0 = (px - H.bx) * H.s, s1 = (b.x - H.bx) * H.s; if (s0 >= 1.2 && s1 < 1.2) { b.x = H.bx + H.s * 1.2; b.vx = -b.vx * .6; b.vy *= .9; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'board', h: hi }); } }
   
   if (b.z < 3.4) { const dx = b.x - H.px, dy = b.y - BK.cy, d = hyp(dx, dy); if (d < 2.8) { const nx = d ? dx / d : 1, ny = d ? dy / d : 0, vn = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny; if (vn < 0) { b.vx -= 1.5 * vn * nx; b.vy -= 1.5 * vn * ny; } b.x = H.px + nx * 2.8; b.y = BK.cy + ny * 2.8; } }
   
   const dxm = (b.x - H.rx) / 10, dym = (b.y - BK.cy) / 10, rho = hyp(dxm, dym) || 1e-6, qx = dxm / rho * .225, qy = dym / rho * .225, ex = dxm - qx, ey = dym - qy, dz = b.z - BK.rz, dd = hyp(ex, ey, dz), Rr = .13;
   if (dd < Rr) { const nx = ex / dd, ny = ey / dd, nz = dz / dd, vx = b.vx / 10, vy = b.vy / 10, vn = vx * nx + vy * ny + b.vz * nz; if (vn < 0) { const k = 1.6; b.vx = (vx - k * vn * nx) * 10; b.vy = (vy - k * vn * ny) * 10; b.vz -= k * vn * nz; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'rim', h: hi }); } b.x = (H.rx / 10 + qx + nx * Rr) * 10; b.y = (BK.cy / 10 + qy + ny * Rr) * 10; b.z = BK.rz + nz * Rr; }
   
   const rh = hyp(b.x - H.rx, b.y - BK.cy) / 10; if (pz > BK.rz && b.z <= BK.rz && rh < .19 && S.shot && !S.shot.made && S.shot.h === hi) { S.shot.made = true; S.pts.push({ t: S.t, team: S.shot.team, n: S.shot.n }); S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'swish', h: hi, n: S.shot.n }); if (S.shot.n === 3) { const rf = E[S.rf]; rf.sig = 3; rf.sigT = S.t + 1.4; } }
   if (b.z < BK.rz && b.z > 2.5 && rh < .3) { b.vx *= .9; b.vy *= .9; b.vz *= .985; b.x += (H.rx - b.x) * .08; b.y += (BK.cy - b.y) * .08; } }
  const W = BK.W; if (b.x < W[0]) { b.x = W[0]; b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx) * .3; } if (b.x > W[2]) { b.x = W[2]; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx) * .3; } if (b.y < W[1]) { b.y = W[1]; b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy) * .3; } if (b.y > W[3]) { b.y = W[3]; b.vy = -Math.abs(b.vy) * .3; } }
 function bkRules(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, u = S.t, n = S.n, rf = E[S.rf], R = S.R;

 function legStep(e, t) { const L = e.L; let x = e.x, y = e.y, vx = 0, vy = 0;
  if (L && t < L.t1) { const D = L.t1 - L.t0, s = cl((t - L.t0) / D, 0, 1), s2 = s * s, s3 = s2 * s, a0 = 2 * s3 - 3 * s2 + 1, a1 = s3 - 2 * s2 + s, a2 = -2 * s3 + 3 * s2, d0 = 6 * s2 - 6 * s, d1 = 3 * s2 - 4 * s + 1, d2 = -6 * s2 + 6 * s;
   x = a0 * L.P0[0] + a1 * D * L.V0[0] + a2 * L.P1[0]; y = a0 * L.P0[1] + a1 * D * L.V0[1] + a2 * L.P1[1]; if (t >= L.t0) { vx = (d0 * L.P0[0] + d1 * D * L.V0[0] + d2 * L.P1[0]) / D; vy = (d0 * L.P0[1] + d1 * D * L.V0[1] + d2 * L.P1[1]) / D; } }
  else if (L) { x = L.P1[0]; y = L.P1[1]; e.L = null; }

  const fx = e.fixH != null && t >= e.fixT, hd = fx ? e.fixH : sp > 8 ? Math.atan2(vy, vx) : e.face ? Math.atan2(e.face[1] - e.y, e.face[0] - e.x) : null;

 function vbRec(S, t, A, tm, r, kind, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, sd = side(tm), s = E.find(e => e.team === tm && e !== r);

 function vbOver(S, t, A, from, kind, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, fr = E[from], tm = 1 - fr.team, sd = side(tm), mine = E.filter(e => e.team === tm);

   const B = [L[0], L[1], BZ], ap = (kind === 'serve' ? 3.5 + R() * 1.6 : kind === 'spike' ? 0 : Math.max(A[2] + .3, 3) + R() * 1.1) + (q > 20 ? .6 + (q - 20) * .1 : 0), tau = kind === 'spike' ? hyp(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]) / spd * (1 + (q % 10) * .1) : tFly(A[2], BZ, ap), t1 = qT(t + Math.max(.3, tau)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1);

 function vbToSetter(S, t, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, r = E[N.j], s = E[N.setter], tm = r.team, sd = side(tm), b = S.B, sy = N.setSpot[1];

  walkTo(df, [VB.nx + so * (40 + R() * 10), cl(VB.cy - (Ap[1] - VB.cy) * .6 + (R() - .5) * 10, VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6)], t, 4.2, [VB.nx, VB.cy]);
  S.next.bl = bl.j; S.next.df = df.j; S.rl = (S.rl || 0) + 1; }
 
 function vbToHitter(S, t, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, s = E[N.j], h = E[N.hitter], tm = h.team, sd = side(tm), b = S.B, Ap = N.Ap;
  const type = R() < .22 ? 'shot' : 'spike', zs = zHand(h.look, 4), J = cl(VB.top + .3 + R() * .14 - zs, .45, .95), jv = Math.sqrt(2 * G * J), ph = Math.atan2(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 40 - Ap[1], -sd * 60);
  const B = ballOn(h.look, Ap[0], Ap[1], ph, 4, J), need = hyp(Ap[0] - h.x, Ap[1] - h.y) / (h.top * 10) * 1.5 + .15;
  const t1 = qT(t + Math.max(tFly(b.z, B[2], Math.max(b.z, B[2]) + 1.1 + R() * .6), need + jv / G)), tj = t1 - jv / G, F = mkF([b.x, b.y, b.z], t, B, t1);
  const bl = E[N.bl], df = E[N.df], so = side(bl.team); let blk = null;
  if (S.blkOn) { const hit = type === 'spike' && R() < .16, tb = t1 + 2 * QG, zb = zHand(bl.look, 4), Jb = cl(NETOK + .06 - BZ - zb, .3, .95), jvb = Math.sqrt(2 * G * Jb), phb = sd > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
   const by = hit ? B[1] : cl(B[1] + (R() < .5 ? -1 : 1) * (7 + R() * 3), VB.y0, VB.y1), ft = [VB.nx + so * 4.5, by], Bb = ballOn(bl.look, ft[0], ft[1], phb, 4, Jb), tjb = tb - jvb / G;
   goTo(bl, ft, t, Math.max(t + .25, tjb - .05)); bl.J = { t0: tjb, v: jvb }; fixAt(bl, phb, tb, 4, tjb, tjb + 2 * jvb / G); blk = { j: bl.j, y: Bb[1], z: Bb[2], hit, tb, B: Bb }; }
  fly(S, F, h.j, 'touch', 'set', { k: 'attack', ev: type, j: h.j, type, blk, dig: S.blkOn ? df.j : null, tm });
  goTo(h, Ap, t, tj - .02); h.J = { t0: tj, v: jv }; fixAt(h, ph, t1, 4, tj, tj + 2 * jv / G);
  goTo(s, [VB.nx + sd * 30, cl(VB.cy - (Ap[1] - VB.cy) * .8, VB.y0 + 8, VB.y1 - 8)], t + .3, t + 1.6, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
 
 function vbBlockOut(S, t, bl) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, b = S.B, A = [b.x, b.y, b.z], atk = 1 - bl.team, sa = side(atk);
  if (R() < .75) for (let q = 0; q < 12; q++) { const L = [VB.nx + sa * (5 + R() * 16), cl(A[1] + (R() - .5) * 16, VB.y0 - 4, VB.y1 + 4)], t1 = qT(t + tFly(A[2], BZ, A[2] + .2 + q * .12)), F = mkF(A, t, [L[0], L[1], BZ], t1); if (fNet(F) < NETOK) continue;
   const ch = E.filter(e => e.team === atk).sort((a, c) => hyp(a.x - L[0], a.y - L[1]) - hyp(c.x - L[0], c.y - L[1]))[0]; fly(S, F, ch.j, 'sand', 'block', null); F.pt = bl.team; F.res = 'block';
   const d = hyp(L[0] - ch.x, L[1] - ch.y), k = Math.max(0, d - 3) / (d || 1); goTo(ch, [ch.x + (L[0] - ch.x) * k, ch.y + (L[1] - ch.y) * k], t, Math.max(t1 + .2, t + .4), [L[0], L[1]]); return; }
  const df = E.find(e => e.team === bl.team && e !== bl); if (vbRec(S, t, A, bl.team, df, 'over', null)) return; vbOver(S, t, A, bl.j, 'over', null); }
 function vbPoint(S, tm, why) { S.pts.push({ t: S.t, team: tm, n: 1 }); S.score[tm]++; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'point', team: tm, why }); S.st = 'dead'; S.deadT = S.t; S.next = null; if (S.srvT !== tm) { S.srvT = tm; S.sk[tm] = 1 - S.sk[tm]; } S.srv = tm * 2 + S.sk[tm]; }
 
 function vbArrive(S, t) { const F = S.F, E = S.E, b = S.B;
  if (F.kind === 'sand') { setMode(S, 'free', t); b.vx = F.vx; b.vy = F.vy; b.vz = F.vz - G * (F.t1 - F.t0); S.ev.push({ t, k: 'mark', x: b.x, y: b.y }); vbFree(S); if (S.st === 'rally') vbPoint(S, F.pt, F.res); return; }
  const e = E[F.j], N = S.next || {}, A = [b.x, b.y, b.z]; S.ev.push({ t, k: N.ev || 'touch', j: e.j, x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z });
  if (N.k === 'catch') { setMode(S, 'held', t); b.held = e.j; e.hold = true; return; }
  if (N.k === 'serve') { S.st = 'rally'; vbOver(S, t, A, e.j, 'serve', null); return; }
  if (N.k === 'bump') { vbToSetter(S, t, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'set') { vbToHitter(S, t, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'attack') { if (N.blk && N.blk.hit) { fly(S, mkF(A, t, N.blk.B, N.blk.tb), N.blk.j, 'touch', N.type, { k: 'block', ev: 'block', j: N.blk.j }); vbDefend(S, t, e.team); } else vbOver(S, t, A, e.j, N.type, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'block') { vbBlockOut(S, t, e); return; }
  setMode(S, 'free', t); }
 
 function vbFree(S) { const b = S.B, px = b.x; b.vz -= G * DT; b.x += b.vx * DT; b.y += b.vy * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; b.roll += hyp(b.vx, b.vy) * DT;
  if (b.z <= BZ) { b.z = BZ; if (b.vz < -1) { b.vz = -b.vz * .18; b.vx *= .35; b.vy *= .35; } else { b.vz = 0; const v = hyp(b.vx, b.vy); if (v > 0) { const nv = Math.max(0, v - 60 * DT); b.vx *= nv / v; b.vy *= nv / v; } } }
  if ((px - VB.nx) * (b.x - VB.nx) <= 0 && px !== b.x && b.y > VB.posts[0] && b.y < VB.posts[1]) { b.x = VB.nx + (Math.sign(px - VB.nx) || 1) * 4.5; b.vx = 0; }
  if (Math.abs(b.x - VB.nx) < 4.5 && b.z < .5) b.x = VB.nx + (Math.sign(b.x - VB.nx) || 1) * 4.5;
  b.x = cl(b.x, VB.W[0] + 6, VB.W[2] - 6); b.y = cl(b.y, VB.W[1] + 6, VB.W[3] - 6); }
 
 function vbPrep(S, t) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, R = S.R, sv = E[S.srv], tm = sv.team, sd = side(tm);
  if (!S.spot) S.spot = [tm ? VB.x1 + 10 : VB.x0 - 10, cl(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 36, VB.y0 + 4, VB.y1 - 4)];
  if (!S.placed) { S.placed = true; S.rl = 0; for (const e of E) { if (e === sv) continue; walkTo(e, e.team === tm ? [VB.nx + sd * 9, cl(VB.cy + (S.spot[1] < VB.cy ? 14 : -14), VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6)] : vbHome(e.team, e.i), t, 2.6, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); } }
  if (b.mode === 'fly' || b.mode === 'lift') return;
  if (b.mode === 'free') { if (b.z > BZ + .02 || hyp(b.vx, b.vy) > 3) return;
   if (S.fetch == null) { const c = E.filter(e => (e.x < VB.nx) === (b.x < VB.nx)).sort((a, q) => hyp(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) - hyp(q.x - b.x, q.y - b.y))[0]; S.fetch = c.j; let ph = Math.atan2(b.y - c.y, b.x - c.x) || 0, f = footFor(c.look, [b.x, b.y], ph, 7); if ((f[0] - VB.nx) * side(c.team) < 3.5) { ph = b.y > c.y ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2; f = footFor(c.look, [b.x, b.y], ph, 7); }
    walkTo(c, f, t, 2.6, [b.x, b.y]); const at = c.L ? c.L.t1 : t; S.pick = { at }; fixAt(c, ph, at + .25, 7, at, at + .55); return; }
   if (t >= S.pick.at + .05) { const c = E[S.fetch]; setMode(S, 'lift', t); S.lift = { j: c.j, t0: t, A: [b.x, b.y, b.z] }; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'pick', j: c.j }); } return; }
  const h = E[b.held]; if (!h) return;
  if (h !== sv) { if (!S.thr) { S.thr = { at: t + .6 }; goTo(sv, [sv.x + sv.vx * .15, sv.y + sv.vy * .15], t, t + .4, [h.x, h.y]); h.face = [sv.x, sv.y]; }
   if (t < S.thr.at || sv.L) return; const ph = Math.atan2(h.y - sv.y, h.x - sv.x), B = ballOn(sv.look, sv.x, sv.y, ph, 2, 0), A = [b.x, b.y, b.z]; let F = null;
   for (let q = 0; q < 14 && !F; q++) { const f = mkF(A, t, B, qT(t + tFly(A[2], B[2], (h.team !== sv.team ? 3.6 : 2.4) + q * .3))); if (fNet(f) >= NETOK) F = f; }
   if (!F) { walkTo(h, [VB.nx + side(h.team) * 30, h.y], t, 2.4, [sv.x, sv.y]); S.thr.at = t + 1.4; return; }
   h.hold = false; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'throw', j: h.j }); fly(S, F, sv.j, 'touch', 'throw', { k: 'catch', ev: 'catch', j: sv.j }); fixAt(sv, ph, F.t1, 2, F.t1 - .35, F.t1 + .05); S.thr = null; S.fetch = null; return; }
  if (!S.walk) { S.walk = 1; walkTo(sv, S.spot, t, 2.4, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
  if (sv.L || t < S.prepT) return;
  const ph = Math.atan2((VB.cy - sv.y) * .3, -sd), J = R() < .35 ? .3 + R() * .25 : 0, B = ballOn(sv.look, sv.x, sv.y, ph, 4, J), A = [b.x, b.y, b.z], t1 = qT(t + tFly(A[2], B[2], B[2] + .7 + R() * .6)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1);
  sv.hold = false; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'toss', j: sv.j }); fly(S, F, sv.j, 'touch', 'toss', { k: 'serve', ev: 'serve', j: sv.j });
  if (J) { const jv = Math.sqrt(2 * G * J); sv.J = { t0: t1 - jv / G, v: jv }; fixAt(sv, ph, t1, 4, t1 - jv / G, t1 + jv / G); } else fixAt(sv, ph, t1, 4, t1 - .35, t1 + .25); S.walk = 0; }
 function vbStep(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, t = S.t + DT;   
  if (b.mode === 'fly') { const F = S.F, p = t >= F.t1 - 1e-6 ? F.B : fAt(F, t); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; b.roll += 2.2; }
  for (const e of E) legStep(e, t);
  for (let a = 0; a < 4; a += 2) { const A = E[a], B = E[a + 1], d = hyp(B.x - A.x, B.y - A.y); if (d < 6.5) { const m = A.ps || A.J ? B : B.ps || B.J ? A : B, o = m === A ? B : A; if (!(m.ps || m.J)) { const k = Math.min(1.2, 6.5 - d) / (d || 1); m.x += (m.x - o.x || .5) * k; m.y += (m.y - o.y) * k; if (m.L) { m.L.P1[0] += (m.x - o.x || .5) * k; m.L.P1[1] += (m.y - o.y) * k; } } } }   
  for (const e of E) { const sd = side(e.team); if ((e.x - VB.nx) * sd < 3) e.x = VB.nx + sd * 3; }   
  if (b.mode === 'fly' && t >= S.F.t1 - 1e-6) vbArrive(S, t);
  if (b.mode === 'held') { const e = E[b.held], p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 2, e.jz); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; }
  else if (b.mode === 'lift') { const L = S.lift, e = E[L.j], u = sm((t - L.t0) / .3), p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 7, e.jz); b.x = lerp(L.A[0], p[0], u); b.y = lerp(L.A[1], p[1], u); b.z = lerp(L.A[2], p[2], u); if (t >= L.t0 + .5) { setMode(S, 'held', t); b.held = L.j; e.hold = true; S.lift = null; } }
  else if (b.mode === 'free') vbFree(S);
  if (S.st === 'prep') vbPrep(S, t);
  if (S.st === 'dead' && t - S.deadT > 1.6) { S.st = 'prep'; S.prepT = t + 2.5; S.spot = null; S.fetch = null; S.placed = false; S.walk = 0; S.thr = null; S.pick = null; if (S.score[0] >= 21 || S.score[1] >= 21) S.ev.push({ t, k: 'game', s: S.score.slice() }); } }
 
 const TOUCH = { serve: 1, pass: 1, dig: 1, set: 1, spike: 1, shot: 1, block: 1, catch: 1 };
 function vbTouchD(S, v, P) { const p = getP(S, v.j, v.t), bb = getB(S, v.t); if (!p || !bb) return 99; const e = S.E[v.j], k = poseK(p.act); if (!HT[k]) return 98; let H;
  if (P && P.pose) { const A = P.pose(Object.assign({}, P.DEF, e.look), { k: ACT[p.act] }, dir8(p.h), 0).arms; H = [p.x + PXH * (A[0].hand[0] + A[1].hand[0]) / 2, p.y + PXH * (A[0].hand[1] + A[1].hand[1]) / 2, (A[0].hand[2] + A[1].hand[2]) / 2 + p.z]; }
  else H = handAt(e.look, p.x, p.y, p.h, k, p.z);
  return hyp(bb.x - H[0], (bb.y - (bb.z - BZ) * PZ - 1.3) - (H[1] - H[2] * PZ)); }
 
 function vbAirCheck(S) { let bad = 0, nf = 0; const modeAt = u => { let m = 'held'; for (const q of S.MD) { if (q[0] > u + 1e-6) break; m = q[1]; } return m; };
  for (let f = 0; f < S.fB; f++) { const u = f / 30, z = S.TB[f * 4 + 2]; if (z < .45) continue; nf++; const m = modeAt(u); if (m === 'held' || m === 'lift') continue; if (m !== 'fly' || !S.FL.some(F => F.t0 <= u + 1e-6 && F.t1 >= u - 1e-6)) bad++; }
  for (const F of S.FL) { if (F.kind !== 'sand') continue; const p0 = getP(S, F.j, F.t0), p1 = getP(S, F.j, F.t1); if (!p0 || !p1) continue; const d0 = hyp(p0.x - F.B[0], p0.y - F.B[1]), d1 = hyp(p1.x - F.B[0], p1.y - F.B[1]); if (!(d1 < d0 - 2 || d1 < 16)) bad++; }
  return { frames: nf, bad }; }
 function vbTouchCheck(n, useP34) { const P = useP34 !== false && typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.P34 : null, out = { sessions: 0, touches: 0, max: 0, sum: 0, over6: 0, byKind: {}, air: 0, airFrames: 0, pose: P && P.pose ? 'P34' : 'table', worst: null };
  for (let i = 0; i < (n || 4); i++) { const S = vbGen((i * 4099 + 7) | 0); simTo(S, S.dur); out.sessions++; for (const v of S.ev) { if (!TOUCH[v.k]) continue; const d = vbTouchD(S, v, P); out.touches++; out.sum += d; if (d > out.max) { out.max = d; out.worst = { s: i, k: v.k, t: +v.t.toFixed(2), d: +d.toFixed(2) }; } if (!(d < 6)) out.over6++; const B = out.byKind[v.k] || (out.byKind[v.k] = { n: 0, max: 0 }); B.n++; B.max = Math.max(B.max, +d.toFixed(2)); }
   const A = vbAirCheck(S); out.air += A.bad; out.airFrames += A.frames; }
  out.mean = out.touches ? +(out.sum / out.touches).toFixed(2) : 0; out.max = +out.max.toFixed(2); delete out.sum; out.ok = out.over6 === 0 && out.air === 0 && out.touches > 0; return out; }

 function auditSess(S, name, area) { const out = { name, frames: 0, bad: 0, why: [], overlap: 0, jumpP: 0, jumpB: 0, outArea: 0, post: 0, events: {} }; simTo(S, S.dur); const n = S.E.length, why = s => { out.bad++; if (out.why.length < 6) out.why.push(name + ': ' + s); };
  for (const v of S.ev) out.events[v.k] = (out.events[v.k] || 0) + 1;
  for (let f = 1; f < S.fP; f++) { const u = S.t0 + f / 15; out.frames++; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const a = (f * n + j) * 6, p = a - n * 6, T = S.TP; if (T[a + 3] === 9) continue; if (!isFinite(T[a]) || !isFinite(T[a + 1])) { why('NaN #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); continue; }
    if (T[p + 3] !== 9 && hyp(T[a] - T[p], T[a + 1] - T[p + 1]) * 15 > 100) { out.jumpP++; why('player jump #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); }
    if (area && (T[a] < area[0] || T[a] > area[2] || T[a + 1] < area[1] || T[a + 1] > area[3])) { out.outArea++; why('out of area #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); }
    for (let q = j + 1; q < n; q++) { const c = (f * n + q) * 6; if (T[c + 3] === 9) continue; const d = hyp(T[a] - T[c], T[a + 1] - T[c + 1]); if (d < 4.2 && !(T[a + 3] === 2 || T[c + 3] === 2 || T[a + 3] === 3 || T[c + 3] === 3 || T[a + 3] >= 10 || T[c + 3] >= 10)) { out.overlap++; if (out.overlap < 3) why('overlap #' + j + '/#' + q + ' ' + d.toFixed(1) + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); } } } }
  for (let f = 1; f < S.fB; f++) { const a = f * 4, p = a - 4, T = S.TB; if (T[a + 2] === -99 || T[p + 2] === -99) continue; if (!isFinite(T[a])) { why('ball NaN'); continue; } if (hyp(T[a] - T[p], T[a + 1] - T[p + 1]) * 30 > 400) { out.jumpB++; why('ball jump at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'match') for (const gx of [A3.x0, A3.x1]) for (const py of [A3.gy - A3.pw, A3.gy + A3.pw]) if (T[a + 2] < A3.cb && hyp(T[a] - gx, T[a + 1] - py) < 1.6) { out.post++; why('ball in post at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'volley' && T[a + 1] > VB.posts[0] && T[a + 1] < VB.posts[1] && T[a + 2] < VB.top - .05 && T[a + 2] > .3 && (T[p] - VB.nx) * (T[a] - VB.nx) < 0) { out.post++; why('ball through the net at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'basket') for (const H of BK.H) if (Math.abs(T[a + 1] - BK.cy) < 8.5 && T[a + 2] > 2.95 && T[a + 2] < 3.9 && (T[p] - H.bx) * (T[a] - H.bx) < 0) { out.post++; why('ball through the board at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); } }
  if (S.kind === 'volley') { out.touch = 0; out.touchMax = 0; for (const v of S.ev) { if (!TOUCH[v.k]) continue; const d = vbTouchD(S, v, null); out.touch++; out.touchMax = Math.max(out.touchMax, +d.toFixed(2)); if (!(d < 6)) why('touch ' + v.k + ' #' + v.j + ' ' + d.toFixed(1) + ' px at ' + v.t.toFixed(2)); }
   const A = vbAirCheck(S); out.air = A.bad; if (A.bad) why('ball in the air with nobody going to it: ' + A.bad); }
  if (S.n === 10) out.games = S.ev.filter(v => v.k === 'game').length;
  out.score = scoreAt(S, S.dur); return out; }

function a4FleetHold(m,dt){if(m.phase==='inbound'&&(m.a5h||m.kind==='fire'||m.kind==='ambulance')&&m.route&&m.route.holds&&!m.route.rbPrep){try{a4FleetRbPrep(m)}catch(e){}}    if(m.waitFleet>0){m.waitFleet-=dt;return true}if(m.phase==='outbound'&&m.route.q34&&!m.route.q34.done){const q=m.route.q34,nd=m.d+m.speed*dt;if(nd>=q.d-.5&&m.d<=q.d+.5){let w=false;for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES]){if(v.x>1136&&v.x<1202&&v.y>3290&&v.y<3408){w=true;break}}if(w&&(m.q34T||0)<q.max){m.q34T=(m.q34T||0)+dt;m.priority=false;A4_FLEET_STATE.q34=(A4_FLEET_STATE.q34||0)+dt;m.state={c:0,r:0,L:{lights:true}};return true}q.done=true;m.q34T=0}}    if(m.phase==='outbound'&&m.route.holds&&!m.route.holds[0].done&&m.d<=.5){const h=m.route.holds[0];let w=false;try{const hy=m.home.y,R=RB2.J12_25,nr=R&&hy-A4_PRIO_BACK-(R.y+R.Ro)<110;for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES,...a4FleetActors()]){if(v===m)continue;if(v.x>1128&&v.x<1212&&v.y>hy-170&&v.y<hy+90){w=true;break}if(nr&&Math.hypot(v.x-R.x,v.y-R.y)<R.Ro+10&&v.y>R.y-20){w=true;break}}}catch(e){}if(w&&(m.holdT||0)<h.max){m.holdT=(m.holdT||0)+dt;m.holdKind='rev';return true}h.done=true;m.holdT=0}
 {const q=a4FleetPose(m.route,Math.min(m.route.total,m.d+2)),tx=q.x-m.x,ty=q.y-m.y,tl=Math.hypot(tx,ty);let fol=false;    
  if(tl>.01)for(const F of a4FleetActors()){if(F===m)continue;if((F.a5h||m.a5h)&&(F.x<545||Math.abs(((F.heading-m.heading+3*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI))-Math.PI)>.6))continue;    
  const dx=F.x-m.x,dy=F.y-m.y,al=(dx*tx+dy*ty)/tl,lat=Math.abs(-dx*ty+dy*tx)/tl;if(al>0&&al<170&&lat<34&&!(F.blocked>1)){fol=true;break}}
  if(!fol&&m.phase==='inbound'&&!m.a5h){let fb=null;try{fb=a4FleetRbFollow(m)}catch(e){}if(fb){fol=true;m.rbBy=fb;A4RB.followT+=dt}}    
  if(fol&&(m.followT||0)<30){m.followT=(m.followT||0)+dt;A4_FLEET_STATE.follows=(A4_FLEET_STATE.follows||0)+dt;return true}if(!fol)m.followT=0}const H=m.route&&m.route.holds;if(!H||m.phase!=='inbound')return false;const nd=m.d+m.speed*dt;
 for(const h of H){if(h.done||m.d>h.d+.5||nd<h.d)continue;let wait=false;
  try{if(h.kind==='signal'){const n=NODES2.get(h.node),mv=n&&n.movements.find(q=>q.id===h.mv);if(mv&&!SignalCore2.movementAllowed(mv,SignalCore2.phaseOf(h.node)))wait=true;}
   else if(h.kind==='station'){if(m.phase==='inbound'&&!m.a5h)for(const F of a4FleetActors()){if(F===m||F.a5h||F.phase!=='inbound')continue;if(F.x>1100&&F.y>2500&&F.y<3430){wait=true;A4_FLEET_STATE.stationWaits=(A4_FLEET_STATE.stationWaits||0)+dt;break}}}    
   else if(h.kind==='er'){wait=true;A2ER.waitT+=dt;if(!h.seen){h.seen=1;A2ER.visits++}}    
   else if(h.kind==='gap'){for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES]){if(v.x>h.x0&&v.x<h.x1&&v.y>h.y0&&v.y<h.y1){wait=true;A2ER.gapT+=dt;break}}}    
   else if(h.kind==='rev'){const hy=m.home.y,R=RB2.J12_25,nr=R&&hy-A4_PRIO_BACK-(R.y+R.Ro)<110;for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES,...a4FleetActors()]){if(v===m)continue;if(v.x>1128&&v.x<1212&&v.y>hy-170&&v.y<hy+90){wait=true;break}if(nr&&Math.hypot(v.x-R.x,v.y-R.y)<R.Ro+10&&v.y>R.y-20){wait=true;break}}}    
   else if(h.kind==='rb'&&RB2[h.node]){const by=a4FleetRbWait(m,h,dt);if(by){wait=true;m.rbBy=by}}    
   else{const R=RB2[h.node];for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES]){const dd=Math.hypot(v.x-R.x,v.y-R.y);if(dd>R.Ro+8||dd<R.Ri-8)continue;const da=((Math.atan2(v.y-R.y,v.x-R.x)-h.a)%(2*Math.PI)+2*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI);if(da<1.5||da>2*Math.PI-.3){wait=true;break}}}
   if(!wait&&h.kind==='rb'&&RB2[h.node]){const xw=rbFleetExitWait3(m,h);if(xw){wait=true;m.rbBy=xw;if((h.max||0)<45)h.max=45}}    
  }catch{}
  if(wait&&(m.holdT||0)<h.max){m.holdT=(m.holdT||0)+dt;m.holdKind=h.kind;if(h.kind!=='rev')m.priority=false;m.state={c:0,r:0,L:{lights:false}};return true}
  h.done=true;m.holdT=0}
 return false}
function a4FleetPathAudit(){const out={poses:0,hits:[],maxTurn:0};const L=parkedStepList();
 for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;
  for(const [ph,route] of [['out',a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home)],['in',a4FleetInbound(cfg,home)]]){let ph0=null;
   for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d);out.poses++;if(ph0!=null){let dh=Math.abs(p.heading-ph0)%(2*Math.PI);if(dh>Math.PI)dh=2*Math.PI-dh;if(dh>out.maxTurn&&dh<3)out.maxTurn=+dh.toFixed(3)}ph0=p.heading;
    const me=vehicleCollisionShape(home.asset,home.ref||'Sedan',p.x,p.y,p.heading);
    for(const o of L){if(o.id===id||Math.abs(o.x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(o.y-p.y)>200)continue;const b=vehicleCollisionShape(o.asset,o.ref||'Sedan',o.x,o.y,o.heading||0);if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,b,1.2)){if(out.hits.length<20)out.hits.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y)+' × '+o.id);break}}}}}}
 const PH=[[1065,3424,0],[1105,3424,0],[700,3424,0],[1231,3060,-Math.PI/2],[1231,2860,-Math.PI/2]];for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;const route=a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home);
  for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d);if(p.x<1100||p.y<3250)continue;const me=vehicleCollisionShape(home.asset,home.ref||'Sedan',p.x,p.y,p.heading);for(const [x,y,h] of PH){if(Math.abs(x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(y-p.y)>200)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,vehicleCollisionShape('VH-SD-02','Sedan',x,y,h),1.2)){if(out.hits.length<20)out.hits.push(id+' out d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y)+' × a car standing at '+x+','+y);break}}}}}
 out.ok=!out.hits.length;return out}
window.a4FleetPathAudit=a4FleetPathAudit;


function a4FleetRoadAudit(){const RD=EDGES.filter(e=>!e.future).map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],L=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);return{id:e.id,a:e.a,b:e.b,ax:a.x,ay:a.y,ux:(b.x-a.x)/L,uy:(b.y-a.y)/L,L,h:roadType(e).width/2}});
 const half={};for(const r of RD){half[r.a]=Math.max(half[r.a]||0,r.h);half[r.b]=Math.max(half[r.b]||0,r.h)}
 const box=(x,y)=>{for(const id in half){const n=byNode[id];if(n&&Math.abs(x-n.x)<=half[id]+2&&Math.abs(y-n.y)<=half[id]+2&&!RB2[id])return id}return null};
 const apron=[];for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const B=A4_FLEET_BAYS.filter(b=>b.fleet===name);if(B.length)apron.push([Math.min(...B.map(b=>b.x)),Math.min(...B.map(b=>b.y))-30,1140,Math.max(...B.map(b=>b.y+b.h))+30])}
 const out={poses:0,off:[],wrong:[],apron:0,cross:0};
 const judge=(x,y,vx,vy)=>{if(apron.some(r=>x>=r[0]&&x<=r[2]&&y>=r[1]&&y<=r[3]))return'apron';
  for(const id in RB2){const R=RB2[id],d=Math.hypot(x-R.x,y-R.y);if(d<=R.Ro+2&&d>=R.Ri-2){const rx=(x-R.x)/d,ry=(y-R.y)/d;return(rx*vy-ry*vx)<.2?'ok':'wrong'}}
  if(box(x,y))return'ok';
  for(const r of RD){const px=x-r.ax,py=y-r.ay,t=px*r.ux+py*r.uy;if(t<0||t>r.L)continue;const lat=-px*r.uy+py*r.ux;if(Math.abs(lat)>r.h+1)continue;const sg=Math.sign(r.ux*vx+r.uy*vy)||1;if(lat*sg>=2)return'ok';const cs=Math.abs(r.ux*vx+r.uy*vy)/Math.hypot(vx,vy);return(cs<.82&&apron.some(q=>y>=q[1]-40&&y<=q[3]+40&&x<1265))?'cross':'wrong'}    
  return'off'};
 for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;
  for(const [ph,route] of [['out',a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home)],['in',a4FleetInbound(cfg,home)]]){
   for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d),q=a4FleetPose(route,Math.min(route.total,d+1.5)),rv=route.rev!=null&&p.segment>=route.rev?-1:1,vx=(q.x-p.x)*rv,vy=(q.y-p.y)*rv;    if(Math.hypot(vx,vy)<.01)continue;out.poses++;const j=judge(p.x,p.y,vx,vy);
    if(j==='apron')out.apron++;else if(j==='cross')out.cross++;else if(j==='off'){if(out.off.length<12)out.off.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y))}else if(j==='wrong'){if(out.wrong.length<12)out.wrong.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y))}}}}}
 out.ok=!out.off.length&&!out.wrong.length;return out}
window.a4FleetRoadAudit=a4FleetRoadAudit;

 
var A4RB={max:90,soft:25,waits:0,maxWait:0,forced:0,yields:0,leads:0,breakT:0,breaks:0,followT:0};
 
 
function a4FleetRbPrep(m){m.route.rbPrep=1;const hl=a4FleetHl(m);
 for(const h of m.route.holds){if(h.kind!=='rb'||!RB2[h.node]||h.rbShift!=null)continue;a4FleetRbGeom(m.route,h);const sh=Math.max(0,Math.min(h.d,hl-4));h.rbShift=sh;h.d-=sh}}
function a4FleetRbFollow(m){if(m.a5h||m.phase!=='inbound'||!m.route||!(m.kind==='fire'||m.kind==='ambulance'))return null;let near=false;
 for(const id of ['J12_25','J12_42']){const R=RB2[id];if(R&&Math.hypot(m.x-R.x,m.y-R.y)<R.Ro+30){near=true;break}}if(!near)return null;
 const hl=a4FleetHl(m),cand=[...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES].filter(v=>Math.abs(v.x-m.x)<170&&Math.abs(v.y-m.y)<170);if(!cand.length)return null;
 for(let s=hl+4;s<=hl+100;s+=4){const p=a4FleetPose(m.route,Math.min(m.route.total,m.d+s));for(const v of cand){const vh=(v.c2&&v.c2.hl)||22;if(Math.hypot(v.x-p.x,v.y-p.y)<13&&s-hl-vh<40)return v.id}if(m.d+s>=m.route.total)break}
 return null}

function a4FleetHl(m){if(!m.hl){try{m.hl=vehicleCollisionShape(m.asset,m.ref||'Sedan',0,0,0).halfLength||30}catch(e){m.hl=30}}return m.hl}
function a4FleetRbGeom(route,h){if(h.rbIn!=null)return h;const R=RB2[h.node];let dIn=null,dOut=null;const end=Math.min(route.total,h.d+1800);
 for(let d=h.d;d<=end;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d),r=Math.hypot(p.x-R.x,p.y-R.y);if(Math.abs(r-R.Rc)<3){if(dIn==null)dIn=d;dOut=d}else if(dIn!=null&&r>R.Rc+3)break}
 if(dIn==null){dIn=h.d;dOut=h.d}const pi=a4FleetPose(route,dIn),po=a4FleetPose(route,dOut);
 h.rbIn=dIn;h.rbOut=dOut;h.thIn=Math.atan2(pi.y-R.y,pi.x-R.x);h.thOut=Math.atan2(po.y-R.y,po.x-R.x);h.rbD=(dOut-dIn)/R.Rc;return h}
 
function a4FleetRingInfo(id){const out=[];if(typeof A4_FLEET_STATE==='undefined')return out;
 for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const st=A4_FLEET_STATE[name],m=st&&st.active;if(!m||m.offsite||m.scene||m.a5h||m.phase!=='inbound'||!m.route||!m.route.holds)continue;
  for(const h of m.route.holds){if(h.kind!=='rb'||h.node!==id||!RB2[id])continue;a4FleetRbGeom(m.route,h);if(m.d<h.d-1||m.d>h.rbOut+80)continue;if(!h.done&&m.d<=h.d+.5)break;
   const R=RB2[id],hl=a4FleetHl(m),sp=((m.holdT||0)>0||(m.blocked||0)>0||(m.waitFleet||0)>0)?0:(m.speed||0);
   if(m.d<h.rbIn)out.push({id:m.id,th:h.thIn,pre:h.rbIn-m.d,post:0,rem:h.rbD,hl,speed:sp});
   else if(m.d<=h.rbOut)out.push({id:m.id,th:Math.atan2(m.y-R.y,m.x-R.x),pre:0,post:0,rem:Math.max(0,h.rbD-(m.d-h.rbIn)/R.Rc),hl,speed:sp});
   else if(m.d-h.rbOut<hl+4)out.push({id:m.id,th:h.thOut,pre:0,post:m.d-h.rbOut,rem:0,hl,speed:sp});
   break}}
 return out}
 
function a4FleetRbWait(m,h,dt){const R=RB2[h.node],node=NODES2.get(h.node),cfg=node&&node.rb;if(!R)return null;if(!h.rbMax){h.rbMax=1;h.max=Math.max(h.max||0,A4RB.max)}a4FleetRbGeom(m.route,h);
 const late=(m.holdT||0)>=A4RB.soft,a0=h.thIn,hl=a4FleetHl(m),pre=Math.max(0,h.rbIn-m.d),win=(cfg?cfg.win:110)+pre*.5,seen=new Set();let by=null;
 if(node)for(const o of node.inside){if(o.remote||o.ghost||o.standing)continue;const v=o.v,c=v&&v.c2;if(!c)continue;seen.add(v.id);let th,pr=0,post=0,rem;
  if(c.mv&&c.mv.rb&&c.mv.node===node.id){const q=rbTheta2(c);th=q.th;pr=q.pre;post=q.post;rem=q.phase===0?c.mv.rb.D:q.phase===1?q.th-c.mv.rb.a1:0}
  else{const m2=(c.next&&c.next.rb&&c.next.node===node.id)?c.next:(c.gate&&c.gate.mv&&c.gate.mv.rb&&c.gate.node===node.id?c.gate.mv:null);if(!m2||!c.lane||c.lane!==m2.from)continue;th=m2.rb.a0;pr=m2.rb.Le+Math.max(0,m2.sStart-c.s);rem=m2.rb.D}
  const up=rbMod2(th-a0);if(up<=rem+.02&&up*R.Rc+pr<(late?hl+c.hl+40:win+(v.speed||0)*1.1)){by=v.id;break}
  const dn=rbMod2(a0-th)*R.Rc;if(pr<1&&dn<c.hl+hl+14-post){by=v.id;break}}
 if(!by){const A=late?.6:1.5;for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES]){if(seen.has(v.id))continue;const dd=Math.hypot(v.x-R.x,v.y-R.y);if(dd>R.Ro+8||dd<R.Ri-8)continue;const da=rbMod2(Math.atan2(v.y-R.y,v.x-R.x)-h.a);if(da<A||da>2*Math.PI-.3){by=v.id;break}}}
 if(!by)for(const F of a4FleetActors()){if(F===m)continue;const dd=Math.hypot(F.x-R.x,F.y-R.y);if(dd>R.Ro+8||dd<R.Ri-8)continue;const da=rbMod2(Math.atan2(F.y-R.y,F.x-R.x)-h.a);if(da<1.5||da>2*Math.PI-.3){by=F.id;break}}
 if(by){A4RB.waits+=dt;A4RB.maxWait=Math.max(A4RB.maxWait,(m.holdT||0)+dt);if((m.holdT||0)+dt>=h.max)A4RB.forced++}
 return by}
 
function a4FleetRbYield(v,mv,node){const R=mv.rb,cfg=node.rb;if(!R||!cfg||!v.c2)return null;
 for(const I of a4FleetRingInfo(node.id)){const up=rbMod2(I.th-R.a0);if(up<=I.rem+.02&&up*R.Rc+I.pre<cfg.win+(I.speed||0)*1.1){A4RB.yields++;return'rb-yield'}
  const dn=rbMod2(R.a0-I.th)*R.Rc;if(I.pre<1&&dn<I.hl+v.c2.hl+14-I.post){A4RB.yields++;return'rb-yield'}}
 return null}
 
function a4FleetRbLead(v,c,R,node,me,myRem,consider){
 for(const I of a4FleetRingInfo(node.id)){if(I.pre>I.hl+8||I.post>I.hl+4)continue;const ah=rbMod2(me.th-I.th);if(ah>Math.min(Math.PI,myRem+.3))continue;if(ah<.02&&me.phase===1&&I.pre>0)continue;
  const gap=me.pre+ah*R.Rc-I.pre-c.hl-(I.post>0?I.hl-I.post:I.hl)-4;A4RB.leads++;consider(gap,{v:null,id:I.id,speed:I.speed||0,kind:'fleet'})}}
 
function a4FleetRbBreak(m,dt,hit){if(!(m.a5h||m.kind==='fire'||m.kind==='ambulance')||(m.blocked||0)<=1)return false;    let near=false;
 for(const id of ['J12_25','J12_42']){const R=RB2[id];if(R&&Math.hypot(m.x-R.x,m.y-R.y)<R.Ro+60){near=true;break}}if(!near)return false;
 const v=[...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES].find(q=>q.id===hit),c=v&&v.c2;if(!c)return false;
 const L=String(c.limitLead||''),mine=c.hardBy===m.id||L===m.id||L===m.id+'+';if(!mine)return false;
 m.yieldHold=true;m.priority=false;A4RB.breakT+=dt;
 if((m.backed||0)<40){const bd=Math.max(0,m.d-20*dt),bp=a4FleetPose(m.route,bd);if(bd<m.d&&!a4FleetBlocked(m,bp)){m.backed=(m.backed||0)+(m.d-bd);m.d=bd;m.x=bp.x;m.y=bp.y;m.heading=bp.heading;m.segment=bp.segment;return true}}
 m.waitFleet=3;m.blocked=Math.max(m.blocked||0,A4_UNJAM_T+.5);A4RB.breaks++;    try{SaveManager.log('a4_fleet','ring_break',{vehicle:m.sourceId,by:hit,x:Math.round(m.x),y:Math.round(m.y)})}catch{}return true}
window.A4RB=A4RB;window.a4FleetRingInfo=a4FleetRingInfo;

function addPedEdge(a,b,type='sidewalk',crosswalkId=null){
 const k=[a,b].sort().join('|')+'|'+type;if(PED_EDGE_KEYS.has(k))return null;PED_EDGE_KEYS.add(k);

}
function buildPedGraph(){
 
 for(const c of CROSSWALKS){const e=byEdge[c.roadId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],horizontal=Math.abs(b.x-a.x)>=Math.abs(b.y-a.y),t=roadType(e),half=t.width/2+SCALE.sidewalk*.52,lead=58;
  let p1,p2,q1,q2;if(horizontal){p1={x:c.x,y:c.y-half};p2={x:c.x,y:c.y+half};q1={x:c.x+lead,y:c.y-half};q2={x:c.x-lead,y:c.y+half}}else{p1={x:c.x-half,y:c.y};p2={x:c.x+half,y:c.y};q1={x:c.x-half,y:c.y+lead};q2={x:c.x+half,y:c.y-lead}}
  const A=addPedNode({id:`PED-${c.id}-A`,...p1,kind:'crosswalk-end',crosswalkId:c.id}),B=addPedNode({id:`PED-${c.id}-B`,...p2,kind:'crosswalk-end',crosswalkId:c.id}),LA=addPedNode({id:`PED-${c.id}-LA`,...q1,kind:'sidewalk'}),LB=addPedNode({id:`PED-${c.id}-LB`,...q2,kind:'sidewalk'});

 }

 }

function trafficLaneCenterOffset(cls,lane=0,dir=1){if(cls==='oneway5')return 0;if(cls==='oneway2')return clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,1)?SCALE.lane/2:-SCALE.lane/2;    if(cls==='main0')return SCALE.mainLane/2+SCALE.mainLane*clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,2);    if(cls==='art21')return dir<0?31:(clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,1)?39:4);    return cls==='track'?11:cls==='main'?SCALE.mainMedian/2+SCALE.mainLane/2+SCALE.mainLane*clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,2):cls==='arterial'?SCALE.median/2+SCALE.lane/2+SCALE.lane*clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,1):SCALE.lane/2}
function trafficPreferredLane(car,e){
 if(e&&e.cls==='oneway2'){if(car?.kind==='bus')return 1;const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=3;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*29+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;return h%2}    
 if(e&&e.cls==='main0'){if(car?.kind==='bus')return 2;const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=5;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*37+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;return h%3}    
 if(e&&e.cls==='main'){if(car?.kind==='bus')return 2;if(!Number.isFinite(car?.lanePref3)){const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=7;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*37+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;if(car)car.lanePref3=h%3;return h%3}return car.lanePref3}    
 if(!e||e.cls!=='arterial')return 0;
 if(car?.kind==='bus')return 1;
 if(Number.isFinite(car?.lanePref))return clamp(Math.round(car.lanePref),0,1);
 const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=0;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*31+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;
 car.lanePref=h%2;return car.lanePref
}
function trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,dirSign,t,lane=0){
 const e=byEdge[edgeId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy),ux=dx/len,uy=dy/len,nx=-uy,ny=ux;
 const off=trafficLaneCenterOffset(e.cls,lane,dirSign),sg=dirSign>0?1:-1;
 const q=dirSign>0?t:1-t;
 return{x:a.x+dx*q+nx*off*sg,y:a.y+dy*q+ny*off*sg,heading:Math.atan2(uy*dirSign,ux*dirSign)}
}

function nearestRoadPosition(x,y,edgeOk=null){
 let best=null;
 for(const e of EDGES){if(edgeOk&&!edgeOk(e))continue;const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(l2<1)continue;const u=clamp(((x-a.x)*dx+(y-a.y)*dy)/l2,0,1),px=a.x+dx*u,py=a.y+dy*u,d=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);if(!best||d<best.d)best={edge:e,u,x:px,y:py,d}}
 return best
}
function taxiPathPx(ids){let d=0;for(let i=1;i<ids.length;i++){const a=byNode[ids[i-1]],b=byNode[ids[i]];if(a&&b)d+=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)}return d}
function taxiFinalClamp(edgeId,dir,t){try{const ln=lane2(edgeId,dir,0);if(!ln)return t;const lo=(ln.boxFrom+34)/ln.len,hi=(Math.min(ln.stopS,ln.len)-34)/ln.len;return hi>lo?clamp(t,lo,hi):t}catch{return t}}    
function taxiApproach(car,x,y){
 const pubRoad=e=>!pgRestrictedEdge(e)&&!e.future&&!e.freightOnly&&!e.oneway;    const pos=nearestRoadPosition(x,y,pubRoad);if(!pos)return null;
 const e=byEdge[car.edgeId],forward=car.dirSign>0?e.b:e.a,targetEdge=pos.edge;
 const sameTravelT=car.dirSign>0?pos.u:1-pos.u;
 if(car.edgeId===targetEdge.id&&sameTravelT>car.t+.05)return{nodes:[forward],pos:0,entryNode:forward,finalEdgeId:car.edgeId,finalDirSign:car.dirSign,finalT:taxiFinalClamp(car.edgeId,car.dirSign,sameTravelT),finalActive:true,targetX:x,targetY:y};
 const pA=shortestNodePath(forward,targetEdge.a,pubRoad),pB=shortestNodePath(forward,targetEdge.b,pubRoad),dA=pA.length?taxiPathPx(pA):Infinity,dB=pB.length?taxiPathPx(pB):Infinity;
 const fromA=dA<=dB,nodes=(fromA?pA:pB);if(!nodes.length)return null;
 return{nodes,pos:0,entryNode:fromA?targetEdge.a:targetEdge.b,finalEdgeId:targetEdge.id,finalDirSign:fromA?1:-1,finalT:taxiFinalClamp(targetEdge.id,fromA?1:-1,fromA?pos.u:1-pos.u),finalActive:false,targetX:x,targetY:y}
}
function taxiCarById(id){return TRAFFIC_CARS.find(v=>v.id===id)}
function taxiAvailable(v){return v?.kind==='taxi'&&!v.taxiRoute&&!v.turn}
function nearestHailableTaxi(maxDist=TAXI_HAIL_DIST){
 if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||State.taxiRide)return null;let best=null;
 for(const v of TRAFFIC_CARS){if(!taxiAvailable(v))continue;const d=Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-v.x,PlayerPed.y-v.y);if(d<=maxDist&&(!best||d<best.d))best={car:v,d}}
 return best
}
function spawnPassengerTaxi(){
 const a=PlayerPed;let best=null;
 for(const edgeId of TRAFFIC_SEED_EDGES){const p=trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,1,.18),d=Math.hypot(a.x-p.x,a.y-p.y);if(!best||d<best.d)best={edgeId,p,d}}
 if(!best)return null;const i=TRAFFIC_CARS.length+1,v={id:'AI-TAXI-SVC-'+Date.now().toString(36),asset:'VS-TX-01',ref:'Taxi',kind:'taxi',label:'מונית',edgeId:best.edgeId,dirSign:1,t:.18,x:best.p.x,y:best.p.y,heading:best.p.heading,speed:0,targetSpeed:86,wait:false,hop:i+3,stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,runKey:null};TRAFFIC_CARS.push(v);return v
}
function routeTaxiCar(car,x,y,phase){
 const r=taxiApproach(car,x,y);if(!r)return false;car.taxiRoute={...r,phase,hold:false,arrived:false};car.plan=null;car.runKey=null;car.targetSpeed=86;car.wait=false;return true
}
function taxiDistanceToPlayer(car){return car?Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-car.x,PlayerPed.y-car.y):Infinity}
function taxiPickupSecondsLeft(ride=State.taxiRide){if(!ride||ride.phase!=='coming')return 0;return Math.max(0,Math.ceil((TAXI_PICKUP_MAX_MS-(performance.now()-(ride.orderedAt||ride.startedAt||performance.now())))/1000))}
function forceTaxiPickupArrival(car){
 const rp=nearestRoadPosition(PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y);if(!car||!rp)return false;const e=rp.edge,cands=[1,-1].map(dirSign=>{const t=dirSign>0?rp.u:1-rp.u,p=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,clamp(t,.04,.96));return{dirSign,t:clamp(t,.04,.96),p,d:Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-p.x,PlayerPed.y-p.y)}}).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d),q=g77TaxiClear(car,e,cands);    
 car.edgeId=e.id;car.dirSign=q.dirSign;car.t=q.t;car.lane=0;    car.x=q.p.x;car.y=q.p.y;car.heading=q.p.heading;car.speed=0;car.turn=null;car.plan=null;car.runKey=null;car.ghost=1;car.wait=true;taxiServiceArrived(car);return true
}
function taxiRideFare(destId){const p=navPoiRegistry()[destId];if(!p)return null;const sn=nearestRoadNode(PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y),tn=nearestRoadNode(p.x,p.y),ids=shortestNodePath(sn.id,tn.id),meters=(taxiPathPx(ids)+sn.d+tn.d)*WORLD_METERS_PER_PX;return{meters,fare:Math.max(18,Math.round(TAXI_BASE_FARE+meters*TAXI_METER_RATE))}}
function beginTaxiCall(car,source='phone'){
 if(State.taxiRide)return toast('כבר יש לך מונית פעילה');if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk')return toast('צא מהרכב כדי להזמין מונית');if(PlayerProfile.activeMission||State.licenseExam)return toast('אי אפשר להזמין מונית בזמן משימה או מבחן');
 car=car||g77TaxiChoose(PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y)||TRAFFIC_CARS.filter(taxiAvailable).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-a.x,PlayerPed.y-a.y)-Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-b.x,PlayerPed.y-b.y))[0]||spawnPassengerTaxi();    if(!car)return toast('אין כרגע מונית זמינה');
 State.g77TaxiDest=null;State.g77TaxiInit=false;State.taxiRide={taxiId:car.id,phase:'coming',source,destId:null,fare:0,startedAt:performance.now(),orderedAt:performance.now(),pickupDeadlineMs:TAXI_PICKUP_MAX_MS};if(!routeTaxiCar(car,PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y,'pickup')){State.taxiRide=null;return toast('לא נמצאה דרך למונית')};SaveManager.log('taxi','called',{taxi:car.id,source});toast(source==='hail'?'המונית עוצרת עבורך':'מונית הוזמנה · היא בדרך אליך');if(State.phoneOpen){State.phoneApp='taxi';renderPhone()}return true
}
function hailNearestTaxi(){const q=nearestHailableTaxi();if(!q)return false;return beginTaxiCall(q.car,'hail')}
function taxiServiceArrived(car){if(car.fuelGo){fuelArrived2(car);return}    
 const ride=State.taxiRide;if(!ride||ride.taxiId!==car.id)return;car.speed=0;car.wait=true;if(car.taxiRoute){car.taxiRoute.hold=true;car.taxiRoute.arrived=true}
 if(ride.phase==='coming'){ride.phase='waiting';SaveManager.log('taxi','pickup_waiting',{taxi:car.id});toast('המונית הגיעה · התקרב ולחץ F או פתח “מונית” בטלפון');if(State.phoneOpen){State.phoneApp='taxi';renderPhone()}}
 else if(ride.phase==='riding')completeTaxiRide(false)
}
function taxiDestinationPois(){
 const here={x:PlayerPed.x,y:PlayerPed.y};
 return Object.values(navPoiRegistry()).filter(p=>!inPortZone(p.x,p.y)&&!/^BUS[123]-/.test(String(p.id))&&!/^(D5-FK-|ACT-)/.test(String(p.id))&&p.id!=='E3-TAXI'&&Math.hypot(p.x-here.x,p.y-here.y)>70).sort((a,b)=>(a.chunk||'').localeCompare(b.chunk||'')||a.label.localeCompare(b.label,'he'))
}
function startTaxiPassengerRide(destId,mode='watch'){
 const ride=State.taxiRide,car=ride&&taxiCarById(ride.taxiId),poi=navPoiRegistry()[destId];if(!ride||ride.phase!=='waiting'||!car||!poi)return toast('המונית עדיין לא מוכנה לנסיעה');
 if(taxiDistanceToPlayer(car)>TAXI_BOARD_DIST)return toast('התקרב למונית כדי לעלות');const q=taxiRideFare(destId);if(!q)return toast('לא ניתן לחשב מסלול');if(PlayerProfile.money<q.fare)return toast('אין מספיק כסף לנסיעה');
 ride.destId=destId;ride.destLabel=poi.label;ride.fare=q.fare;ride.meters=q.meters;ride.phase='riding';ride.mode=mode;ride.startedAt=performance.now();car.taxiRoute=null;car.plan=null;car.wait=false;
 if(mode==='skip'){return skipTaxiRideToDestination()}
 if(!routeTaxiCar(car,poi.x,poi.y,'dropoff')){ride.phase='waiting';return toast('לא נמצאה דרך ליעד')}
 setPhoneOpen(false);PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;SaveManager.log('taxi','ride_started',{taxi:car.id,dest:destId,fare:q.fare,mode});toast('הנסיעה התחילה · אפשר לצפות או לפתוח טלפון ולדלג ליעד');return true
}
function placeTaxiAtDestination(car,poi){
 const rp=nearestRoadPosition(poi.x,poi.y);if(rp){car.edgeId=rp.edge.id;car.dirSign=1;car.t=clamp(rp.u,.05,.95);const p=trafficEdgePoint(car.edgeId,car.dirSign,car.t);car.x=p.x;car.y=p.y;car.heading=p.heading}else{car.x=poi.x;car.y=poi.y}car.speed=0;car.turn=null;car.plan=null;car.taxiRoute=null
}
function skipTaxiRideToDestination(){
 const ride=State.taxiRide;if(!ride||ride.phase!=='riding')return false;const car=taxiCarById(ride.taxiId),poi=navPoiRegistry()[ride.destId];if(!car||!poi)return false;placeTaxiAtDestination(car,poi);return completeTaxiRide(true)
}
function completeTaxiRide(skipped=false){
 const ride=State.taxiRide;if(!ride||ride.phase!=='riding')return false;const car=taxiCarById(ride.taxiId),poi=navPoiRegistry()[ride.destId];if(!car||!poi)return false;
 const fare=ride.fare||0;PlayerProfile.money=Math.max(0,PlayerProfile.money-fare);recordTransaction('taxi-fare',-fare,{destination:ride.destId,skipped:!!skipped});PlayerPed.x=car.x-Math.sin(car.heading)*34;PlayerPed.y=car.y+Math.cos(car.heading)*34;PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;car.taxiRoute=null;car.plan=null;car.wait=false;car.speed=0;car.hop+=2;State.taxiRide=null;SaveManager.log('taxi','ride_completed',{destination:ride.destId,fare,skipped:!!skipped});toast(`הגעת ל-${poi.label} · ${money(fare)}${skipped?' · דילוג ליעד':''}`);Camera.x=PlayerPed.x;Camera.y=PlayerPed.y;if(State.phoneOpen){State.phoneApp='taxi';renderPhone()}return true
}
function cancelTaxiService(){
 const ride=State.taxiRide;if(!ride)return false;if(ride.phase==='riding')return toast('במהלך נסיעה אפשר לדלג ליעד, לא לבטל');
 const car=taxiCarById(ride.taxiId);if(car){car.taxiRoute=null;car.plan=null;car.wait=false;car.speed=0;car.hop+=1}State.taxiRide=null;SaveManager.log('taxi','cancelled',{});toast('הזמנת המונית בוטלה');if(State.phoneOpen)renderPhone();return true
}
function updateTaxiPassenger(){
 const ride=State.taxiRide;if(!ride)return;const car=taxiCarById(ride.taxiId);if(!car){State.taxiRide=null;return}
 if(ride.phase==='coming'){const elapsed=performance.now()-(ride.orderedAt||ride.startedAt||performance.now());if(elapsed>=TAXI_PICKUP_FORCE_MS&&!ride.pickupForced){ride.pickupForced=true;forceTaxiPickupArrival(car);SaveManager.log('taxi','pickup_deadline_assist',{taxi:car.id,elapsed:Math.round(elapsed)});return}}
 if(ride.phase==='riding'){g77TaxiWatchdog(ride,car);PlayerPed.x=car.x;PlayerPed.y=car.y;PlayerPed.heading=car.heading;PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false}
}

function busSiteBack(x,y){return fleetFieldAt(x,y)?30:BUS_SITE_BACK}function busSiteFwd(x,y){return fleetFieldAt(x,y)?46:BUS_SITE_FWD}   
function staticHouseCollisionAt(x,y,r){for(const l0 of LOTS){const l=l0.kind==='player'?{...l0,kind:'static',preview:'PH-L5'}:l0,f=canonicalAssetFit(l);if(!f)continue;const inf=TurboCity.info(f.assetId||l.preview,{scale:f.s,rot:f.rot}),fp=inf.fp;if(circleRectHit(x,y,r,{x:f.x+fp[0],y:f.y+fp[1],w:fp[2],h:fp[3]}))return l.id}return null}
function staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,r){if(!inActiveRegion(x,y))return'WORLD';return a6CollisionAt(x,y,r,true)|| c5CollisionAt(x,y,r)||a4CollisionAt(x,y,r,true)||b5CollisionAt(x,y,r)||e3RailCollision(x,y,r)||e4RailCollision(x,y,r)||e5RailCollision(x,y,r)||b2CollisionAt(x,y,r,true)||c2CollisionAt(x,y,r)||d2CollisionAt(x,y,r)||c4CollisionAt(x,y,r)||staticHouseCollisionAt(x,y,r)||landscapeCollisionAt(x,y,r)||d3CollisionAt(x,y,r)||b3CollisionAt(x,y,r)||null}
function busSiteFrame(edgeId,dirSign,t){const e=byEdge[edgeId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy),sg=dirSign>0?1:-1,ux=dx/len*sg,uy=dy/len*sg,q=sg>0?t:1-t,roadW=roadType(e)?.width||SCALE.local;return{e,a,b,len,roadW,ux,uy,nx:-uy,ny:ux,rx:a.x+dx*q,ry:a.y+dy*q,horizontal:Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy)}}
function busShelterRot(nx,ny){return Math.abs(nx)<.5?(ny<0?0:2):(nx>0?1:3)}
 
function busSiteJunctionOk(F,sg){const dA=Math.hypot(F.rx-F.a.x,F.ry-F.a.y),dB=Math.hypot(F.rx-F.b.x,F.ry-F.b.y),cw=(F.e.cls==='arterial'||F.e.cls==='main')?34:30,req=(n,ext)=>n.type==='boundary'||(n.type==='joint'&&incident(n.id).length<=2)||(n.id==='J46_185'&&sg>0&&/^D3-RE-C/.test(F.e.id))?0:nodeRadius(n)+cw+12+ext+6,extFor=node=>((node===F.b)===(sg>0))?busSiteFwd(F.rx,F.ry):busSiteBack(F.rx,F.ry);return dA>=req(F.a,extFor(F.a))&&dB>=req(F.b,extFor(F.b))}
function busSiteClear(edgeId,dirSign,t,short){const sg=dirSign>0?1:-1,F=busSiteFrame(edgeId,dirSign,t);if(!busSiteJunctionOk(F,sg))return null;const half=F.roadW/2;for(let s=-(short?30:busSiteBack(F.rx,F.ry));s<=(short?46:busSiteFwd(F.rx,F.ry));s+=9)for(const d of[5,10,15]){const x=F.rx+F.ux*s+F.nx*(half+d),y=F.ry+F.uy*s+F.ny*(half+d);if(staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,4)||parkingInfoAt(x,y))return null}for(const c of CROSSWALKS){const dx=c.x-F.rx,dy=c.y-F.ry;if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<64)return null;if(!fleetFieldAt(F.rx,F.ry)){const al=dx*F.ux+dy*F.uy,lat=Math.abs(-dx*F.uy+dy*F.ux);if(lat<F.roadW/2+14&&Math.abs(al)<BUS_SITE_FWD+6)return null}}return F}    
const BUS_SITE_TAKEN=[],BUS_PHYS=[],BUS_BAY={entry:40,stop:150,exit:40,depth:30};    
function busBayBlock(F,half){for(let s=-80;s<=80;s+=10)for(let d=BUS_BAY.depth-8;d<=BUS_BAY.depth+20;d+=7){const dd=Math.min(d,BUS_BAY.depth+19.5),x=F.rx+F.ux*s+F.nx*(half+dd),y=F.ry+F.uy*s+F.ny*(half+dd),a0=staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,3),a=(a0==='WATER'&&dd>BUS_BAY.depth+8)?null:a0,p=parkingInfoAt(x,y);if(a||p)return String(a||(p&&(p.id||p.lot))||'?')}return null}    
function busStopSite(edgeId,dirSign,t0,range=170,short){const e=byEdge[edgeId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],len=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);for(let d=0;d<=range;d+=6)for(const sgn of(d?[1,-1]:[1])){const t=t0+sgn*d/len;if(t<.02||t>.98)continue;const F=busSiteClear(edgeId,dirSign,t,short);if(!F)continue;const sx=F.rx+F.nx*(F.roadW/2+10),sy=F.ry+F.ny*(F.roadW/2+10);if(BUS_SITE_TAKEN.some(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-sx,o.y-sy)<96))continue;return{t,F}}return null}

function termPathOf(pts){const lens=[0];for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)lens.push(lens[i-1]+Math.hypot(pts[i].x-pts[i-1].x,pts[i].y-pts[i-1].y));return{pts,lens,total:lens[lens.length-1]}}
function termAt(path,s){s=Math.max(0,Math.min(path.total,s));const L=path.lens;let lo=0,hi=L.length-1;while(hi-lo>1){const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;if(L[mid]<=s)lo=mid;else hi=mid}const f=(s-L[lo])/Math.max(1e-6,L[hi]-L[lo]),p=path.pts[lo],q=path.pts[hi];return{x:p.x+(q.x-p.x)*f,y:p.y+(q.y-p.y)*f}}
function termPose(path,s){const p=termAt(path,s),a=termAt(path,s-5),b=termAt(path,s+5);return{x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x)}}
function termArcPts(cx,cy,r,a0,a1){const n=Math.max(3,Math.ceil(Math.abs(a1-a0)/(Math.PI/36))),out=[];for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const a=a0+(a1-a0)*i/n;out.push({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r})}return out}
function termJoin(...A){const out=[];for(const a of A)for(const p of a){const l=out[out.length-1];if(!l||Math.hypot(l.x-p.x,l.y-p.y)>.05)out.push({x:p.x,y:p.y})}return out}
function termSub(P,s0,s1){s0=Math.max(0,Math.min(P.total,s0));s1=Math.max(0,Math.min(P.total,s1));const out=[termAt(P,s0)];for(let i=0;i<P.pts.length;i++){const L=P.lens[i];if(L>s0+.05&&L<s1-.05)out.push(P.pts[i])}out.push(termAt(P,s1));return out}
function termSCurveY(x0,y0,dir,D,dy){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<=14;i++){const u=i/14;out.push({x:x0+dir*D*u,y:y0+dy*(1-Math.cos(Math.PI*u))/2})}return out}

function termAheadBlocked(bus,x,y,h){const me=vehicleCollisionShape(bus.asset,bus.ref||'Bus',x,y,h),fx=Math.cos(h),fy=Math.sin(h),ahead=o=>((o.x-x)*fx+(o.y-y)*fy)>-6;

function termStep(bus,m,dt){const P=m.path,room=Math.max(0,P.total-m.s);

 const vWant=Math.min(TERM.vTrack,Math.sqrt(2*TERM.decel*room)+(room>.8?1.2:0));if(vWant<m.v)m.v=Math.max(vWant,m.v-TERM.brake*dt);else m.v=Math.min(vWant,m.v+TERM.accel*dt);

 if(ds>.004&&!(m.ghost>0)){hit=termAheadBlocked(bus,p.x,p.y,p.heading);if(!hit&&termXwBusy(p))hit='XW'}

  const o=hit!=='XW'&&BUS_VEHICLES.find(q=>q.id===hit),mutual=!!(o&&o.term&&o.term.hitBy===bus.id&&o.term.blockT>2);    
  if(hit!=='XW'&&mutual&&m.blockT>4){m.ghost=3;m.blockT=0;TERM.stats.ghosts++}bus.wait=true;bus.speed=0;return false}

function pointSegmentDistanceSq(px,py,ax,ay,bx,by){const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(l2<1e-8){const x=px-ax,y=py-ay;return x*x+y*y}const t=clamp(((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2,0,1),x=ax+t*dx-px,y=ay+t*dy-py;return x*x+y*y}
function orient2d(ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy){return(bx-ax)*(cy-ay)-(by-ay)*(cx-ax)}
function segmentsIntersect2d(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h){const o1=orient2d(a,b,c,d,e,f),o2=orient2d(a,b,c,d,g,h),o3=orient2d(e,f,g,h,a,b),o4=orient2d(e,f,g,h,c,d);return((o1>0&&o2<0)||(o1<0&&o2>0))&&((o3>0&&o4<0)||(o3<0&&o4>0))}
function segmentDistanceSq(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h){if(segmentsIntersect2d(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h))return 0;return Math.min(pointSegmentDistanceSq(a,b,e,f,g,h),pointSegmentDistanceSq(c,d,e,f,g,h),pointSegmentDistanceSq(e,f,a,b,c,d),pointSegmentDistanceSq(g,h,a,b,c,d))}
function vehicleBodiesOverlap(a,b,pad=1.2){const rr=a.radius+b.radius+pad;return segmentDistanceSq(a.ax,a.ay,a.bx,a.by,b.ax,b.ay,b.bx,b.by)<rr*rr}
function pointHitsVehicleBody(px,py,r,b,pad=0){const rr=b.radius+r+pad;return pointSegmentDistanceSq(px,py,b.ax,b.ay,b.bx,b.by)<rr*rr}

function pgStraddles(a,sh,pad=0){
 
 const r=sh.radius+pad,N=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(sh.bx-sh.ax,sh.by-sh.ay)/(sh.radius*.5)));

 return false}

  if(a.laneSet.has(c.lane.id)){const L=a.lineS[c.lane.id];if(L==null)return null;const d=L-c.s-c.hl;return d>=-1?Math.max(0,d):null}
  if(c.gate&&a.laneSet.has(c.gate.lane.id))return Math.max(0,c.gateDist)+PG_T.BACK;return null}
 if(a.type==='grant-out'){if(c.mv&&a.laneSet.has(c.mv.to.id))return 0;if(!c.mv&&c.gate&&a.laneSet.has(c.gate.mv.to.id))return Math.max(0,c.gateDist)+PG_T.BACK;return null}

function pgTick(now){

  const L=cands.get(a).sort((p,q)=>(p.kind==='fl'?0:1)-(q.kind==='fl'?0:1)||(p.kind==='fl'?p.eta-q.eta:p.dist-q.dist));

  const holderC=a.holder?L.find(c=>c.id===a.holder):null,holderHere=!!holderC||env.has(a.holder);
  for(const c of L)if(!c.auth&&c.kind==='player'&&c.dist<70){a.stats.denied++;pgDenyToast(a)}
  
  
  if(a.state!=='OPEN'){const need=(a.state==='OPENING'?0:a.state==='CHECKING'&&a.hk==='fl'?Math.max(0,PG_T.CHECK.fl-a.t):PG_T.CHECK.fl)+(1-a.ang)*PG_T.OPEN;
   const late=auth.find(c=>c.kind==='fl'&&(env.has(c.id)||(jump&&c.eta<need-.05)))||(jump?auth.find(c=>env.has(c.id)):null);
   if(late){a.holder=late.id;a.hk=late.kind;a.ang=1;pgSet(a,'OPEN');a.stats.snap=(a.stats.snap||0)+1;pgLog(a,'snap',{who:late.id,jump})}}
  if(a.state==='CLOSED'){a.ang=0;if(auth.length){a.holder=auth[0].id;a.hk=auth[0].kind;pgSet(a,'CHECKING');pgLog(a,'check',{who:a.holder})}else a.holder=null}
  else if(a.state==='CHECKING'){
   const fl=auth.find(c=>c.kind==='fl'&&c.eta<=PG_T.FL_URGENT);if(fl&&a.holder!==fl.id&&!env.has(a.holder)){a.holder=fl.id;a.hk='fl';a.t=Math.min(a.t,PG_T.CHECK.fl*.5)}
   if(!holderHere){if(auth.length){a.holder=auth[0].id;a.hk=auth[0].kind;a.t=0}else{a.holder=null;pgSet(a,a.ang>0?'CLOSING':'CLOSED')}}
   else{a.t+=dt;if(a.t>=(PG_T.CHECK[a.hk]??1)){pgSet(a,a.ang>=1?'OPEN':'OPENING');pgLog(a,'admit',{who:a.holder,kind:a.hk})}}}
  else if(a.state==='OPENING'){a.ang=Math.min(1,a.ang+dt/PG_T.OPEN);if(a.ang>=1)pgSet(a,'OPEN')}
  else if(a.state==='OPEN'){a.ang=1;a.openT+=dt;
   const stale=holderC&&holderC.kind!=='fl'&&holderC.dist>40&&a.openT>PG_T.HOLD_IDLE&&!env.has(a.holder);
   if(!holderHere||stale){if(!stale){a.stats.passes++;a.stats.byKind[a.hk]=(a.stats.byKind[a.hk]||0)+1;pgLog(a,'pass',{who:a.holder,kind:a.hk})}
    const next=auth.find(c=>c.id!==a.holder);if(next){a.holder=next.id;a.hk=next.kind;pgSet(a,'CHECKING')}else{a.holder=null;pgSet(a,'CLOSING')}}}
  else if(a.state==='CLOSING'){
   if(env.size){a.stats.reopen++;pgLog(a,'reopen',{who:[...env][0]});pgSet(a,'OPENING');const c=auth.find(q=>env.has(q.id));if(c){a.holder=c.id;a.hk=c.kind}}
   else{a.ang=Math.max(0,a.ang-dt/PG_T.CLOSE);if(a.ang<=0){pgSet(a,'CLOSED');a.holder=null}}}
  
  for(const id of env){if(a.ang<.98){a.stats.lowOnBody=(a.stats.lowOnBody||0)+1;if(/^FL-/.test(id))a.stats.flOpenLate++;if((a.stats.lowIds||(a.stats.lowIds=[])).length<6)a.stats.lowIds.push(id+'@'+a.state)}}
 }
}
function pgDenyToast(a){if(SIM.t-PG_STATE.toastAt<8)return;PG_STATE.toastAt=SIM.t;PG_STATE.stats.denied++;
 try{if(PlayerProfile.mode==='vehicle'||PlayerProfile.mode==='walk')toast(a.gate.label+' · כניסה למורשים בלבד — '+(a.gate.intercom?'היתר כניסה באינטרקום (F)':'השער נפתח רק לרכבי הנמל'))}catch{}}


function pgArmOpenFor(a,id){return a.state==='OPEN'&&a.ang>=.98&&a.holder===id}
function pgCarWall(x,y,heading){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;const sh=vehicleCollisionShape(PlayerCar.asset,PlayerCar.ref||'Sedan',x,y,heading),r=sh.radius;
 if(!PG_GATES.some(g=>{const [p,q]=g.line;return Math.abs(x-(p[0]+q[0])/2)<420&&Math.abs(y-(p[1]+q[1])/2)<420})&&!pgNearFence(x,y,420))return null;
 const hitSeg=(p,q,w)=>pgSegDist(sh.ax,sh.ay,sh.bx,sh.by,p[0],p[1],q[0],q[1])<r+w;
 for(const [p,q] of PG_FENCE)if(hitSeg(p,q,1.5))return 'PORT-FENCE';
 for(const g of PG_GATES){for(const [p,q] of g.wickets)if(hitSeg(p,q,1.5))return g.id+':WICKET';
  if(g.booth&&circleRectHit(x,y,r,{x:g.booth[0]-13,y:g.booth[1]-10,w:26,h:20}))return g.id+':BOOTH';
  for(const a of g.arms){if(pgArmOpenFor(a,'PLAYER'))continue;if(!hitSeg(a.p0,a.p1,1.5))continue;
   
   const da=pgSigned(a,sh.ax,sh.ay),db=pgSigned(a,sh.bx,sh.by),P0=pgSigned(a,PlayerCar.x,PlayerCar.y),P1=pgSigned(a,x,y);
   if(Math.min(da,db)-r<-.5&&Math.max(da,db)+r>.5&&Math.abs(P1)>Math.abs(P0))continue;
   return a.id}}
 return null}
function pgNearFence(x,y,m){return PG_FENCE.some(([p,q])=>x>Math.min(p[0],q[0])-m&&x<Math.max(p[0],q[0])+m&&y>Math.min(p[1],q[1])-m&&y<Math.max(p[1],q[1])+m)}
function pgPersonWall(x,y,r){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;if(!pgNearFence(x,y,60)&&!PG_GATES.some(g=>{const [p,q]=g.line;return Math.abs(x-(p[0]+q[0])/2)<160&&Math.abs(y-(p[1]+q[1])/2)<160}))return null;
 const d=(p,q)=>Math.sqrt(pointSegmentDistanceSq(x,y,p[0],p[1],q[0],q[1]));
 for(const [p,q] of PG_FENCE)if(d(p,q)<r+1.5)return 'PORT-FENCE';
 const auth=pgPlayerAuthorized();
 for(const g of PG_GATES){const ain=g.arms.find(a=>a.dir==='in'),out=((x-PlayerPed.x)*ain.n[0]+(y-PlayerPed.y)*ain.n[1])<0,ok=auth||out;   

  if(g.booth&&circleRectHit(x,y,r,{x:g.booth[0]-13,y:g.booth[1]-10,w:26,h:20}))return g.id+':BOOTH';
  for(const a of g.arms)if(d(a.p0,a.p1)<r+1.5)return a.id;
  for(const [p,q] of g.wickets)if(d(p,q)<r+1.5){if(ok){g.wicketOpenT=SIM.t;continue}PG_STATE.stats.wicketDenied++;if(SIM.t-PG_STATE.toastAt>8){PG_STATE.toastAt=SIM.t;try{toast(g.label+' · שער הולכי רגל למורשים בלבד — היתר באינטרקום (F)')}catch{}}return g.id+':WICKET'}}
 return null}

function pgNearIntercom(){
 if(!PG_STATE.ready)return null;const walk=PlayerProfile.mode==='walk',p=walk?PlayerPed:PlayerCar;if(!walk&&carKmh()>3)return null;
 let best=null;for(const g of PG_GATES){if(!g.intercom)continue;const d=Math.hypot(p.x-g.intercom[0],p.y-g.intercom[1]);if(d<=(walk?46:95)&&(!best||d<best.d))best={g,d}}
 return best?best.g:null}

 PlayerProfile.money-=fee;ensureActivitySchema().certs['PORT-PASS']={at:iso(),by:State.interactionId||'PG'};recordTransaction('port-permit',-fee,{gate:State.interactionId});
 SaveManager.log('port','permit_bought',{gate:State.interactionId});SaveManager.save('port-permit',{backup:true,silent:true});toast('היתר כניסה לנמל נרכש · השער ייפתח לך');renderPhone()}

 return body}

function pgStructureAudit(){
 pgInit();const issues=[],R=[];
 const plans=[]    ,    gates=PG_GATES.filter(g=>g.kind==='gate'),chk=PG_GATES.filter(g=>g.kind==='checkpoint');    
 for(const p of plans)if(!gates.some(g=>g.plan===p))issues.push('missing gate '+p);
 if(gates.length!==0||chk.length!==1)    issues.push(`gates ${gates.length} / checkpoints ${chk.length}`);
 
 let lanesChecked=0;
 for(const g of PG_GATES){const e=byEdge[g.road];if(!e){issues.push(g.id+': road '+g.road);continue}
  if(g.arms.length!==2||!g.arms.some(a=>a.dir==='in')||!g.arms.some(a=>a.dir==='out'))issues.push(g.id+': arms');
  for(const l of LANE_LIST2.filter(l=>l.edge===g.road)){const [p,q]=g.line,dx=q[0]-p[0],dy=q[1]-p[1],den=l.ux*dy-l.uy*dx;if(Math.abs(den)<1e-6){issues.push(g.id+': lane parallel '+l.id);continue}
   const t=((p[0]-l.ax)*dy-(p[1]-l.ay)*dx)/den,cx=l.ax+l.ux*t,cy=l.ay+l.uy*t;
   const a=g.arms.find(a=>l.ux*a.n[0]+l.uy*a.n[1]>.7);if(!a){issues.push(g.id+': no arm for '+l.id);continue}
   const at=pgAlong(a,cx,cy);if(at<8||at>a.len-8)issues.push(`${g.id}: lane ${l.id} crosses at ${at.toFixed(0)} of ${a.len.toFixed(0)}`);lanesChecked++}}
 
 
 const near=(x,y,[p,q],m)=>pointSegmentDistanceSq(x,y,p[0],p[1],q[0],q[1])<=m*m;
 const gaps=[];
 for(let i=0;i<PG_ZONE.length;i++){const [p,q]=[PG_ZONE[i],PG_ZONE[(i+1)%PG_ZONE.length]],L=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);
  for(let s=0;s<=L;s+=4){const x=p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*s/L,y=p[1]+(q[1]-p[1])*s/L;
   if(x>=5999||y>=5059||(Math.abs(y-4300)<=1&&x>5729&&x<5941))continue;   
   if(PG_FENCE.some(f=>near(x,y,f,2.5))||PG_GATES.some(g=>near(x,y,g.line,2.5)))continue;
   if(gaps.length<6)gaps.push(Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y))}}
 if(gaps.length)issues.push('boundary gaps '+gaps.join(' '));
 
 for(const x of [5750,5800,5850,5900,5920])if(!personBlockedAt(x,4300,5))issues.push('rail corridor open at '+x);    
 
 let crossings=0;const crossedAt=new Set();
 for(const e of EDGES){const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],L=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(L/4));let prev=inPortZone(a.x,a.y);
  for(let k=1;k<=n;k++){const x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*k/n,y=a.y+(b.y-a.y)*k/n,cur=inPortZone(x,y);if(cur===prev)continue;prev=cur;
   const mx=x-(b.x-a.x)/n/2,my=y-(b.y-a.y)/n/2;if(mx>=5999||my>=5059)continue;crossings++;
   const g=PG_GATES.find(g=>(g.kind==='gate'||g.boundary)&&near(mx,my,g.line,6));if(g)crossedAt.add(g.id);else issues.push(`road ${e.id} crosses the boundary at ${Math.round(mx)},${Math.round(my)} without a gate`)}}
 if(crossedAt.size!==1)issues.push('roads cross the boundary at '+crossedAt.size+' gates');            
 
 let acc=0;for(const l of LANE_LIST2){const mid=lanePose2(l,l.len/2),inside=inPortZone(mid.x,mid.y);if(l.acc){acc++;if(l.public)issues.push('public port lane '+l.id)}else if(inside)issues.push('lane inside without access class '+l.id)}
 for(const id of PG_APPROACH)for(const l of LANE_LIST2.filter(l=>l.edge===id))if(!l.acc)issues.push('approach without access class '+l.id);
 let pubLanes=0;for(const l of LANE_LIST2){if(!l.public)continue;pubLanes++;if(l.ptNext&&l.ptNext.to.acc)issues.push('public lane passes into the port '+l.id+'>'+l.ptNext.to.id);
  if(!l.moves.some(m=>m.to.public))issues.push('public lane without a public exit '+l.id)}
 for(const id of TRAFFIC_SEED_EDGES){const e=byEdge[id];if(!e||pgRestrictedEdge(e)||!trafficPublicEdge(e))issues.push('seed edge '+id)}
 const taxiIn=taxiDestinationPoisAll().filter(p=>inPortZone(p.x,p.y)).length;if(taxiIn)issues.push('taxi destinations inside '+taxiIn);
 
 for(const g of PG_GATES){if(g.intercom){const [x,y]=g.intercom;if(inPortZone(x,y))issues.push(g.id+': intercom inside');}
  for(const [p,q] of g.wickets)if(!near((p[0]+q[0])/2,(p[1]+q[1])/2,g.line,1))issues.push(g.id+': wicket off the gate line')}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,20),gates:gates.length,checkpoints:chk.length,arms:PG_STATE.arms.length,lanesChecked,boundaryRoads:crossings,gatesCrossed:crossedAt.size,portLanes:acc,publicLanes:pubLanes,restrictedEdges:PG_RESTRICTED_IDS.size,fenceSegments:PG_FENCE.length}}
function taxiDestinationPoisAll(){const save=PlayerPed.x,saveY=PlayerPed.y;PlayerPed.x=-99999;PlayerPed.y=-99999;try{return taxiDestinationPois()}finally{PlayerPed.x=save;PlayerPed.y=saveY}}

function pgAuthAudit(){
 pgInit();const issues=[],use={};
 const crosses=(edges)=>{const out=new Set();for(const a of PG_STATE.arms)for(const seg of edges){const l=lane2(seg.edgeId,seg.dirSign,0);if(!l)continue;if(a.laneSet.has(l.id)||a.armLane===l)out.add(a.id)}return [...out]};

function trafficBoxHalf(nodeId,edgeInId){
 const e=byEdge[edgeInId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],hx=b.x-a.x,hy=b.y-a.y,hl=Math.hypot(hx,hy)||1;let half=0;
 for(const q of trafficIncident(nodeId)){if(q.id===edgeInId)continue;const qa=byNode[q.a],qb=byNode[q.b],qx=qb.x-qa.x,qy=qb.y-qa.y,ql=Math.hypot(qx,qy)||1,c=Math.abs((hx*qx+hy*qy)/(hl*ql));if(c>.94)continue;half=Math.max(half,TYPES[q.cls].width/2)}
 return half
}
function trafficReseed(seed=777){
 let s=(seed>>>0)||1;const rnd=()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
 TRAFFIC_JUNCTION_LOCKS.clear();
 TRAFFIC_CARS.forEach((car,i)=>{if(car.c5||car.taxiRoute||!/^AI-CAR-/.test(car.id))return;const lap=Math.floor(i/TRAFFIC_SEED_EDGES.length),edgeId=TRAFFIC_SEED_SLOTS[i]||car.edgeId,e=byEdge[edgeId];if(!e)return;
  const dirSign=rnd()<.5?1:-1,t=lap===0?.14+rnd()*.34:.58+rnd()*.24,lane=e.cls==='main'?(car.lanePref3??i%3):e.cls==='arterial'?(car.lanePref??i%2):0,p=trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,dirSign,t,lane);
  Object.assign(car,{edgeId,dirSign,t,lane,laneTarget:lane,x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading,speed:0,wait:false,hop:i+Math.floor(rnd()*7),stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,ptPlan:null,turn:null,runKey:null,junctionLock:null,junctionTicket:null,junctionLockNext:null,junctionTicketNext:null,plan2:null,recoveryBoost:0,deadlockRelease:0,hardEpisodes:0,queueWatchdogs:0,backouts:0,commitCooldown:0,hardEvent:false,stuckEvent:false})});
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES){b.deadlockRelease=0;b.recoveries=0;b.freezeRecoveries=0;b.hardEpisodes=0;b.queueWatchdogs=0;b.backouts=0}
 for(const v of (typeof D4_YARD_SEMIS==='undefined'?[]:D4_YARD_SEMIS)){v.deadlockRelease=0;v.recoveries=0;v.hardEpisodes=0;v.backouts=0}

 return{seed,cars:TRAFFIC_CARS.length}
}

function trafficRoadActors(){
 const out=[];
 for(const c of TRAFFIC_CARS){if(c.c5&&c.c5.mode!=='road')continue;out.push({v:c,kind:'car'})}
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES)out.push({v:b,kind:'bus'});
 for(const s of (typeof D4_YARD_SEMIS==='undefined'?[]:D4_YARD_SEMIS))if(s.k==='road')out.push({v:s,kind:'semi'});
 return out
}
function trafficLegitStop(r){const v=r.v;if(r.kind==='bus')return !!(v.term||v.dwell>0||v.airport4);if(r.kind==='car')return !!(v.taxiRoute?.hold);return false}
function trafficReleaseTotal(){let n=0;for(const r of trafficRoadActors())n+=(r.v.deadlockRelease||0)+(r.v.backouts||0);return n}
