function trafficHealthSample(now=performance.now(),windowS=60){
 const t=now/1000;TRAFFIC_HEALTH.t=t;const rows=trafficRoadActors();let frozen=0,legit=0,over=0;const frozenIds=[],overIds=[];
 for(const r of rows){const v=r.v;let h=TRAFFIC_HEALTH.hist.get(v.id);if(!h){h=[];TRAFFIC_HEALTH.hist.set(v.id,h)}h.push([t,v.x,v.y]);while(h.length&&t-h[0][0]>windowS+.01)h.shift();
  if(t-h[0][0]<windowS-.1)continue;let maxd=0;for(const q of h)maxd=Math.max(maxd,Math.hypot(q[1]-v.x,q[2]-v.y));
  if(maxd<4){if(trafficLegitStop(r))legit++;else{frozen++;frozenIds.push(v.id+'@'+(v.edgeId||'?'))}}}
 const sh=rows.map(r=>trafficVehicleShape(r.v));
 for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<rows.length;j++){if(Math.abs(rows[i].v.x-rows[j].v.x)>150||Math.abs(rows[i].v.y-rows[j].v.y)>150)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(sh[i],sh[j],1.2)){over++;overIds.push(rows[i].v.id+'/'+rows[j].v.id)}}
 let waiting=0,committed=0;for(const r of rows){if(r.v.wait)waiting++;if(r.v.junctionLock)committed++}
 return{t:+t.toFixed(1),actors:rows.length,frozen,frozenLegit:legit,frozenIds:frozenIds.slice(0,24),over,overIds:overIds.slice(0,8),waiting,committed,releases:trafficReleaseTotal(),locks:TRAFFIC_JUNCTION_LOCKS.size,passThroughNodes:TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size}
}

function traffic01Audit(){
 
 
 const issues=[];
 const deg2=NODES.filter(n=>trafficIncident(n.id).length===2),expectedPass=deg2.filter(n=>!SIGNALS.some(s=>s.node===n.id)&&!CROSSWALKS.some(c=>c.signalNode===n.id)).length;
 if(TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size!==expectedPass)issues.push(`pass-through set ${TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size}≠${expectedPass}`);
 for(const id of TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH)if(SIGNALS.some(s=>s.node===id))issues.push(id+': signalized node marked pass-through');
 for(const id of ['D3N','D3A2','B2S','D2E-AIR','D3E'])if(byNode[id]&&!TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.has(id))issues.push(id+': expected pass-through');
 for(const id of ['D3S','AIR-W0','B3C1','J54_26','J61_26'])if(TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.has(id))issues.push(id+': junction marked pass-through');
 if(!TrafficCore2.ready)issues.push('Road Core v2 not initialised');
 for(const id of TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH){const n=NODES2.get(id);if(!n||!n.pt)issues.push(id+': not a pass-through node in the lane graph')}
 let checked=0;
 for(const lane of LANE_LIST2){const n=NODES2.get(lane.nodeTo);if(!n||n.pt||n.dead)continue;checked++;
  if(lane.stopS>lane.len-lane.boxTo+.01)issues.push(lane.id+': stop line inside the box');
  const cw=CROSSWALKS.find(c=>c.signalNode===lane.nodeTo&&c.roadId===lane.edge);if(cw){const nn=byNode[lane.nodeTo],d=Math.hypot(cw.x-nn.x,cw.y-nn.y);if(lane.len-lane.stopS<d-.01)issues.push(lane.id+': stop line on the crosswalk')}
  for(const m of lane.moves)if(m.sStart<lane.stopS-.01){issues.push(lane.id+': curve starts before the stop line');break}}
 if(!(TRAFFIC_FOLLOW_GAP>=10&&CORE2.BOX_MARGIN>=4&&CORE2.BACKOUT_AFTER>=6))issues.push('constants');
 if(TrafficSignalController.core!==2)issues.push('signals not on Signal Core v2');
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues:issues.slice(0,12),passThrough:TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.size,approachesChecked:checked,deg2:deg2.length}
}


function rightTurnAudit2(){
 const issues=[];let n=0;const hd=(a,b)=>{let d=Math.abs(a-b)%(2*Math.PI);return d>Math.PI?2*Math.PI-d:d};
 if(!(CORE2.R_RIGHT<=38))issues.push('R_RIGHT '+CORE2.R_RIGHT);
 for(const m of MOVES2.values()){if(m.kind!=='right')continue;n++;
  if(m.to.k!==m.to.cnt-1)issues.push(m.id+': not the outer exit lane');
  const p=m.pts;if(p.length<3)continue;const h0=Math.atan2(p[1].y-p[0].y,p[1].x-p[0].x),h1=Math.atan2(p[p.length-1].y-p[p.length-2].y,p[p.length-1].x-p[p.length-2].x);
  if(hd(h0,m.from.heading)>.35)issues.push(m.id+': curve leaves against the approach');if(hd(h1,m.to.heading)>.35)issues.push(m.id+': curve joins against the exit')}
 if(!n)issues.push('no right-turn movements');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,8),rightTurns:n}
}

function trafficDrive(car,dt,desired,lead){
 const reserve=lead?TRAFFIC_FOLLOW_GAP+Math.min(12,car.speed*.09):0,safeGap=lead?Math.max(0,lead.gap-reserve):Infinity;
 if(lead)desired=Math.min(desired,Math.sqrt(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL*safeGap)+(safeGap>0?2:0));
 const openRoad=!lead||lead.gap>Math.max(86,car.speed*.82+34),restart=openRoad&&car.speed<22;
 const accel=(car.recoveryBoost>0?TRAFFIC_RESTART_ACCEL*1.08:restart?TRAFFIC_RESTART_ACCEL:openRoad?TRAFFIC_ACCEL:TRAFFIC_ACCEL*.72);
 if(car.recoveryBoost>0)car.recoveryBoost=Math.max(0,car.recoveryBoost-dt);
 if(desired<car.speed)car.speed=Math.max(desired,car.speed-TRAFFIC_BRAKE_MAX*dt);else car.speed=Math.min(desired,car.speed+accel*dt);
 return safeGap
}

const TRAFFIC_TURN_R=56;
function trafficTurnR(e,nextEdge){const l1=Math.hypot(byNode[e.b].x-byNode[e.a].x,byNode[e.b].y-byNode[e.a].y),l2=Math.hypot(byNode[nextEdge.b].x-byNode[nextEdge.a].x,byNode[nextEdge.b].y-byNode[nextEdge.a].y);return Math.max(18,Math.min(TRAFFIC_TURN_R,l1*.4,l2*.4))}
function trafficSignedTurn(a,b){return Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a))}
function trafficLaneIntersection(p1,h1,p2,h2){
 const u1={x:Math.cos(h1),y:Math.sin(h1)},u2={x:Math.cos(h2),y:Math.sin(h2)},cross=u1.x*u2.y-u1.y*u2.x;if(Math.abs(cross)<1e-5)return null;
 const dx=p2.x-p1.x,dy=p2.y-p1.y,t=(dx*u2.y-dy*u2.x)/cross;return{x:p1.x+u1.x*t,y:p1.y+u1.y*t,u1,u2}
}
function trafficPlanTo(car,e,next,dirSign=car.dirSign){
 if(!next?.edge)return null;
 const baseR=trafficTurnR(e,next.edge),l1=Math.hypot(byNode[e.b].x-byNode[e.a].x,byNode[e.b].y-byNode[e.a].y),l2=Math.hypot(byNode[next.edge.b].x-byNode[next.edge.a].x,byNode[next.edge.b].y-byNode[next.edge.a].y),h0=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,.5,0).heading,h1=trafficEdgePoint(next.edge.id,next.dirSign,.5,0).heading,delta=trafficSignedTurn(h0,h1),right=delta>.25&&delta<2.75,left=delta<-.25&&delta>-2.75,ang=Math.abs(delta),R=right?Math.min(baseR,38):left?Math.min(baseR,58):baseR;
 const sourceLane=e.cls==='main'?(right?2:left?0:trafficPreferredLane(car,e)):e.cls==='arterial'?(right?1:left?0:trafficPreferredLane(car,e)):0;
 const nextLane=next.edge.cls==='main'?(right?2:left?0:trafficPreferredLane(car,next.edge)):next.edge.cls==='arterial'?(right?1:left?0:(e.cls==='arterial'?sourceLane:trafficPreferredLane(car,next.edge))):0;
 const hin=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,.5,sourceLane).heading,hout=trafficEdgePoint(next.edge.id,next.dirSign,.5,nextLane).heading;
 let ts=1-R/Math.max(l1,1),te=R/Math.max(l2,1),rightGeom=null;
 if(right){
  const pin=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dirSign,1,sourceLane),pout=trafficEdgePoint(next.edge.id,next.dirSign,0,nextLane),g=trafficLaneIntersection(pin,hin,pout,hout);
  if(g){const d=R,from={x:g.x-g.u1.x*d,y:g.y-g.u1.y*d,heading:hin},to={x:g.x+g.u2.x*d,y:g.y+g.u2.y*d,heading:hout},din=(pin.x-from.x)*g.u1.x+(pin.y-from.y)*g.u1.y,dout=(to.x-pout.x)*g.u2.x+(to.y-pout.y)*g.u2.y,nts=1-din/Math.max(l1,1),nte=dout/Math.max(l2,1),arcR=d/Math.max(.18,Math.tan(ang/2)),k=Math.max(5,(4/3)*Math.tan(ang/4)*arcR);
   if(nts>.015&&nts<.985&&nte>.015&&nte<.985){ts=nts;te=nte;rightGeom={from,to,c1:{x:from.x+g.u1.x*k,y:from.y+g.u1.y*k},c2:{x:to.x-g.u2.x*k,y:to.y-g.u2.y*k},k}}
  }
 }
 const nodeId=dirSign>0?e.b:e.a,passThrough=TRAFFIC_PASS_THROUGH.has(nodeId)&&next.edge.id!==e.id&&ang<2.5,boxHalf=passThrough?0:trafficBoxHalf(nodeId,e.id);
 return{next,R,ts,te,ang,delta,right,left,sourceLane,nextLane,rightGeom,cap:ang<.2?car.targetSpeed:ang>2.5?24:right?34:ang>1?38:52,nodeId,dirIn:dirSign,passThrough,boxHalf}
}
function trafficHeadingDiff(a,b){return Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin((a||0)-(b||0)),Math.cos((a||0)-(b||0))))}



function updateTrafficCars(dt){TRAFFIC_FRAME++;TrafficCore2.tick(dt)}   


const BUS_CURB_APPROACH=105,BUS_CURB_EXIT=44,BUS_CURB_MARGIN=3,BUS_CURB_MAX_SHIFT=24;
function busSmooth01(t){t=clamp(t,0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)}
function busStopCurbShift(bus,stop){
 const e=byEdge[stop.edgeId],lane=trafficLaneCenterOffset(e.cls,bus.lane||0,stop.dirSign),r=trafficVehicleRadius(bus);
 return Math.max(0,stop.bay?stop.roadHalf+BUS_BAY.depth-r-BUS_CURB_MARGIN-lane:Math.min(BUS_CURB_MAX_SHIFT,stop.roadHalf-r-BUS_CURB_MARGIN-lane))    
}

const BUS_FREEZE_RECOVER_SECONDS=9.5;

var __BRM;
function busRouteMetrics(bus){
 const route=busRouteForLine(bus.line);let T=(__BRM||(__BRM=new WeakMap())).get(route);
 if(!T||T.n!==route.length){const L=[],cuLen=[0];let s=0;for(let i=0;i<route.length;i++){const e=byEdge[route[i].edgeId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],l=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y));L.push(l);s+=l;cuLen.push(s)}T={n:route.length,L,cuLen,total:s};(__BRM||(__BRM=new WeakMap())).set(route,T)}
 const ri=bus.routeIndex;let pos;
 if(!Number.isInteger(ri)){pos=0;for(let i=0;i<route.length;i++){if(i<ri)pos+=T.L[i];else if(i===ri)pos+=T.L[i]*clamp(bus.t||0,0,1)}}
 else if(ri>=route.length)pos=T.cuLen[route.length];else if(ri>=0)pos=T.cuLen[ri]+T.L[ri]*clamp(bus.t||0,0,1);else pos=0;
 return{total:T.total,pos}
}
function busGapAheadSameLine(bus){
 const m=busRouteMetrics(bus);let best=Infinity;
 for(const o of BUS_VEHICLES){if(o===bus||o.line!==bus.line||o.term)continue;const q=busRouteMetrics(o);let d=q.pos-m.pos;if(d<=0)d+=m.total;if(d<best)best=d}
 return best
}
function busAntiBunchCap(bus){
 const gap=busGapAheadSameLine(bus);
 
 if(!Number.isFinite(gap))return bus.targetSpeed;
 if(gap<=105)return 0;
 if(gap<180)return 18+(gap-105)*.18;
 if(gap<360)return 32+(gap-180)*.18;
 return bus.targetSpeed
}

function busPhysOf(o){return o&&o.phys?BUS_PHYS.find(q=>q.id===o.phys):null}
function busPhysWaiting(o){return o.phys?ALL_BUS_STOPS.reduce((a,s)=>a+(s.phys===o.phys?busPassengerStop(s.id).waiting:0),0):busPassengerStop(o.id).waiting}


var TCSTOP = (function () {
  'use strict';
  const K = .6, M = 10, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const nrm = v => { const n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] };
  const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
  const LD = nrm([-0.42, -0.55, 0.72]), VW = nrm([0, K, 1]), HV = nrm([LD[0] + VW[0], LD[1] + VW[1], LD[2] + VW[2]]);
  const AMB = .62, DIF = .38, TOPB = AMB + DIF * LD[2];

  function box(g, F, s0, s1, d0, d1, z0, z1, col, mat) {

      [F.N(0, 1), [[s0, d1, z0], [s1, d1, z0], [s1, d1, z1], [s0, d1, z1]]], [F.N(0, -1), [[s0, d0, z0], [s1, d0, z0], [s1, d0, z1], [s0, d0, z1]]]];

const SAVE_LS_MAX=256*1024,SAVE_PTR_KEY='turbo_city_save_ptr_v1';
const SAVE_IDB={db:null,ok:null,opening:null,err:null};
const SAVE_ST={saves:0,lastMs:0,maxMs:0,chars:0,mode:'ls',seq:0,idbPuts:0,idbFail:0,idbMs:0,bootAsync:false,bootMs:0};
function saveLsPtr(){try{const p=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_PTR_KEY);return p?JSON.parse(p):null}catch{return null}}
function saveIdbOpen(){if(SAVE_IDB.opening)return SAVE_IDB.opening;SAVE_IDB.opening=new Promise(res=>{try{if(!window.indexedDB){SAVE_IDB.ok=false;return res(null)}const rq=indexedDB.open('turbo_city',1);
 rq.onupgradeneeded=()=>{const db=rq.result;if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains('saves'))db.createObjectStore('saves')};rq.onsuccess=()=>{SAVE_IDB.db=rq.result;SAVE_IDB.ok=true;res(SAVE_IDB.db)};
 rq.onerror=()=>{SAVE_IDB.ok=false;SAVE_IDB.err=String(rq.error);res(null)}}catch(e){SAVE_IDB.ok=false;SAVE_IDB.err=String(e);res(null)}});return SAVE_IDB.opening}
function saveIdbPut(key,val){return saveIdbOpen().then(db=>new Promise(res=>{if(!db)return res(false);const t0=performance.now();try{const tx=db.transaction('saves','readwrite');tx.objectStore('saves').put(val,key);
 tx.oncomplete=()=>{SAVE_ST.idbPuts++;SAVE_ST.idbMs+=performance.now()-t0;res(true)};tx.onerror=tx.onabort=()=>{SAVE_ST.idbFail++;SAVE_IDB.err=String(tx.error);res(false)}}catch(e){SAVE_ST.idbFail++;SAVE_IDB.err=String(e);res(false)}}))}
function saveIdbGet(key){return saveIdbOpen().then(db=>new Promise(res=>{if(!db)return res(null);try{const rq=db.transaction('saves','readonly').objectStore('saves').get(key);rq.onsuccess=()=>res(rq.result??null);rq.onerror=()=>res(null)}catch{res(null)}}))}
window.__TC_SAVE=()=>({...SAVE_ST,idbMs:+SAVE_ST.idbMs.toFixed(1),idb:SAVE_IDB.ok,idbErr:SAVE_IDB.err,ptr:saveLsPtr(),lsChars:(()=>{try{return(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||'').length}catch{return -1}})()});

function validateSave(d){const errors=[];if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return{ok:false,errors:['not-object']};if(d.metadata?.saveVersion!==SAVE_VERSION)errors.push('saveVersion');
 const p=d.player?.position,v=d.currentVehicle?.position;if(!p||!Number.isFinite(p.x)||!Number.isFinite(p.y))errors.push('player.position');if(!v||!Number.isFinite(v.x)||!Number.isFinite(v.y))errors.push('vehicle.position');
 if(v&&!worldContains(v.x,v.y))errors.push('vehicle.position.bounds');if(p&&Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y)&&!worldContains(p.x,p.y))errors.push('player.position.bounds');if(typeof d.player?.money!=='number')errors.push('player.money');
 if(!d.garage||!Array.isArray(d.garage.vehicles))errors.push('garage');if(!d.home||!Number.isInteger(d.home.homeLevel))errors.push('home');if(!d.progression||!Array.isArray(d.progression.discoveredChunks))errors.push('progression');
 if(!d.licenses||typeof d.licenses!=='object')errors.push('licenses');if(!d.settings||typeof d.settings!=='object')errors.push('settings');return{ok:errors.length===0,errors}}
function migrateSave(d){if(!d||typeof d!=='object')throw new Error('Invalid save');let v=d.metadata?.saveVersion??0;if(v===0){d={...d,metadata:{...(d.metadata||{}),saveVersion:1,gameVersion:VER,buildId:BUILD,createdAt:d.metadata?.createdAt||iso(),updatedAt:iso()},licenses:d.licenses||{'LIC-01':{state:'owned',acquiredAt:'migration-v0',bestScore:null,attempts:0}},settings:d.settings||cloneJson(PlayerProfile.settings)};v=1}if(v!==SAVE_VERSION)throw new Error('Unsupported save version '+v);return d}

}

function enterVehicle(){if(State.ferryRide)return false;if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk')return false;const target=nearestDriveableVehicle();if(!target){toast('התקרב לרכב חונה או לרכב תנועה שעצר כדי להיכנס');return false}if(target.id!=='PLAYER-CAR'){parkCurrentPlayerCar();let origin=null;if(target.traffic){origin=trafficReturnOrigin(target.trafficRef);const i=TRAFFIC_CARS.indexOf(target.trafficRef);if(i>=0)TRAFFIC_CARS.splice(i,1)}else if(target.loanOrigin){origin=cloneJson(target.loanOrigin);removeWorldParked(target.id)}else if(target.playerOwned){removeWorldParked(target.id)}else{origin=parkedReturnOrigin(target);removeWorldParked(target.id)}PlayerCar.asset=target.asset;PlayerCar.ref=fleetRefBase(target.ref)||'Sedan';PlayerCar.state=cloneJson(target.state||{});PlayerCar.x=target.x;PlayerCar.y=target.y;PlayerCar.heading=target.heading||0;State.borrowedVehicleOrigin=origin;State.borrowedReturnArmed=false;State.borrowedReturnFarSeconds=0;if(origin){State.vehicleEcoOverride=cloneJson(target.eco||{fuel:40,damage:0,borrowed:true});State.vehicleEcoOverride.borrowed=true}else State.vehicleEcoOverride=null}else{State.borrowedReturnArmed=false;State.borrowedReturnFarSeconds=0}PlayerProfile.mode='vehicle';PlayerCar.speed=0;PlayerCar.steer=0;SaveManager.log('player_enter_vehicle',{distance:rd(target.d),vehicle:PlayerCar.asset,source:target.id,traffic:!!target.traffic,borrowed:!!State.borrowedVehicleOrigin});toast(target.traffic?'נכנסת לרכב שעצר בתנועה · '+PlayerCar.asset:'נכנסת לרכב · '+PlayerCar.asset);return true}
function toggleVehicle(){if(actScanShift())return toast('במשמרת סריקה עובדים ברגל — סיים או בטל את המשמרת');if(State.taxiRide)return toast(State.taxiRide.phase==='riding'?'אתה נוסע כרגע במונית':'המונית שלך פעילה — השתמש ב-F או באפליקציית מונית');return PlayerProfile.mode==='vehicle'?exitVehicle():enterVehicle()}
function updatePed(dt){if(State.ferryRide){a6PlacePassenger();return}if(State.a6Harvest){PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;return}if(State.taxiRide?.phase==='riding'){PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;return}if(State.fishingSession?.busy||State.fishingSetup){PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;return}const dx=(Input.down('KeyD','ArrowRight')?1:0)-(Input.down('KeyA','ArrowLeft')?1:0),dy=(Input.down('KeyS','ArrowDown')?1:0)-(Input.down('KeyW','ArrowUp')?1:0),mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy),run=Input.down('ShiftLeft','ShiftRight'),speed=run?90:52;if(mag>.01){const ux=dx/mag,uy=dy/mag,nx=PlayerPed.x+ux*speed*dt,ny=PlayerPed.y+uy*speed*dt;PlayerPed.dir=personDirection(ux,uy);PlayerPed.heading=Math.atan2(uy,ux);PlayerPed.pose=run?'running':'walking';PlayerPed.moving=true;const hit=personBlockedAt(nx,ny);if(!hit){PlayerPed.x=nx;PlayerPed.y=ny;PlayerProfile.stats.distanceMeters+=speed*dt*WORLD_METERS_PER_PX}else{SaveManager.log('ped_collision',{hit})}}else{PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false}}
function fishingWaterPoint(spotId,now=0){const spot=fishingSpotById(spotId)||nearbyB2FishingSpot(90);if(!spot)return{x:PlayerPed.x+40,y:PlayerPed.y};if(spot.water){let x=spot.water.x,y=spot.water.y;if(spot.habitat==='coastal'){const dx=x-spot.x,dy=y-spot.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,target=Math.max(92,d*1.28),phase=(stableHash(spot.id)%997)/997*Math.PI*2;x=spot.x+dx/d*target;y=spot.y+dy/d*target;if(now){x+=Math.sin(now/1150+phase)*3.2;y+=Math.sin(now/760+phase*.73)*1.8}}return{x,y}}if(spot.wdir)return{x:spot.x+spot.wdir[0]*60,y:spot.y+spot.wdir[1]*60};let dx=B2_LAKE.cx-spot.x,dy=B2_LAKE.cy-spot.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;return{x:spot.x+dx/d*72,y:spot.y+dy/d*72}}

function mapBaseFinish(){
 const B=MAPBASE;
 for(let i=1;i<B.levels.length;i++){const a=B.levels[i-1],b=B.levels[i];b.ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;b.ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';b.ctx.clearRect(0,0,b.cv.width,b.cv.height);b.ctx.drawImage(a.cv,0,0,a.cv.width,a.cv.height,0,0,b.cv.width,b.cv.height)}
 B.done=true}

function mapBaseStep(now){
 const B=MAPBASE;if(now<1500)return;
 if(!B.total){mapBaseReset();return}
 if(B.done){if(B.key!==mapBaseKey())mapBaseReset();return}
 if(cv.width!==B.cw||cv.height!==B.ch){mapBaseReset();return}
 const t0=performance.now(),k=B.next,col=k%B.cols,row=(k/B.cols)|0,tx=B.x+col*B.tw,ty=B.y+row*B.th,s=B.scale,sv={x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,zoom:Camera.zoom};
 Camera.x=tx+B.tw/2;Camera.y=ty+B.th/2;Camera.zoom=s/dpr;
 ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(s,0,0,s,0,0);ctx.translate(-tx,-ty);ctx.fillStyle='#0a1218';ctx.fillRect(tx,ty,B.tw,B.th);
 B.pass=true;try{mapBaseLayers(now)}catch(e){B.errors++;B.lastError=String(e&&e.message||e)}finally{B.pass=false}
 ctx.restore();
 for(const r of mapBakeRegions()){const x0=Math.max(r.x,tx),x1=Math.min(r.x+r.w,tx+B.tw),y0=Math.max(r.y,ty),y1=Math.min(r.y+r.h,ty+B.th);if(x1<=x0||y1<=y0)continue;B.levels[0].ctx.drawImage(cv,(x0-tx)*s,(y0-ty)*s,(x1-x0)*s,(y1-y0)*s,Math.round((x0-B.x)*s),Math.round((y0-B.y)*s),Math.round((x1-x0)*s),Math.round((y1-y0)*s))}
 Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y;Camera.zoom=sv.zoom;Targets.begin();
 B.next++;if(B.next>=B.total)mapBaseFinish();
 B.tileMs.push(Math.round(performance.now()-t0))}

 for(const r of MAP_PLANNED_ROADS){c.beginPath();if(r.axis==='h'){c.moveTo(T.x(r.a),T.y(r.p));c.lineTo(T.x(r.b),T.y(r.p))}else{c.moveTo(T.x(r.p),T.y(r.a));c.lineTo(T.x(r.p),T.y(r.b))}c.stroke()}
 c.setLineDash([]);c.globalAlpha=1;
 if(!B.done&&!B.rebake){c.fillStyle='#31583b';for(const r of ACTIVE_REGIONS)c.fillRect(T.x(r.x),T.y(r.y),r.w*T.s,r.h*T.s);drawExactC3Map(c,T,true);drawE3Map(c,T)}   
 if(B.levels&&(B.done||B.next>0||B.rebake)){const L=B.done?mapLevelFor(T.s):B.levels[0];    c.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;c.imageSmoothingQuality='high';c.drawImage(L.cv,0,0,L.cv.width,L.cv.height,T.x(B.x),T.y(B.y),B.w*T.s,B.h*T.s)}
 c.restore()}
function mapHaloText(c,t,x,y,fill,halo,lw){c.lineWidth=lw||3;c.strokeStyle=halo||'rgba(6,12,18,.88)';c.lineJoin='round';c.strokeText(t,x,y);c.fillStyle=fill;c.fillText(t,x,y)}

function drawMapZones(c,T,o){
 c.save();const here=currentChunkId(),W=o.w||1e5,H=o.h||1e5,labels=o.pass==='labels',put=(t,x,y,f,h,lw)=>{if(!o.dry)mapHaloText(c,t,x,y,f,h,lw)};
 for(const q of MAP_CHUNKS){
  const act=MAP_SHOWN_IDS.has(q.id),x=T.x(q.x),y=T.y(q.y),w=q.w*T.s,h=q.h*T.s;if(x+w<0||y+h<0||x>W||y>H)continue;
  if(!labels){
   if(!act&&w>46){c.save();c.beginPath();c.rect(x,y,w,h);c.clip();c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.07)';c.lineWidth=1;for(let k=-h;k<w;k+=14){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x+k,y+h);c.lineTo(x+k+h,y);c.stroke()}c.restore()}
   if(q.id===here){c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.07)';c.fillRect(x,y,w,h)}
   c.strokeStyle=q.id===here?'rgba(255,255,255,.92)':act?'rgba(255,224,138,.85)':'rgba(190,210,222,.30)';c.lineWidth=q.id===here?(o.lw||1.4)+.8:act?(o.lw||1.4):1;if(!act)c.setLineDash([5,5]);c.strokeRect(x+.5,y+.5,w-1,h-1);c.setLineDash([])}
  else if(w>38){
   const fs=clamp(w/10,9,16);c.font='700 '+fs+'px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textBaseline='alphabetic';
   if(act){c.textAlign='left';put(q.id,x+6,y+fs+3,'#ffe08a');let lw=fs*2.1;if(w>118){c.font='600 '+Math.max(9,fs-3)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';put(q.name,x+6+fs*1.9,y+fs+3,'rgba(255,244,214,.92)',null,2.6);lw+=c.measureText(q.name).width+4}if(o.rects)o.rects.push({x:x+3,y:y+2,w:lw+4,h:fs+8})}
   else if(!o.dry){c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.globalAlpha=.8;mapHaloText(c,q.id,x+w/2,y+h/2-(w>110?fs*.5:0),'rgba(215,228,236,.8)','rgba(6,12,18,.7)',2.6);if(w>110){c.font='600 '+Math.max(9,fs-3)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';mapHaloText(c,q.name,x+w/2,y+h/2+fs*.7,'rgba(190,208,220,.75)','rgba(6,12,18,.7)',2.4)}c.globalAlpha=1}}}
 c.restore()}


const MAP_PIN_COLORS={transport:'#3a8fe0',service:'#3aa86a',commerce:'#b562c9',industry:'#d0643b',energy:'#d6b12f',port:'#6c5ce7',home:'#e0a43a',nature:'#1fa3a8'};
const MAP_KIND_CAT={train:'transport',bus:'transport',car:'service',fuel:'service',gear:'service',cross:'service',school:'service',bag:'commerce',hotel:'commerce',office:'commerce',box:'industry',factory:'industry',bolt:'energy',anchor:'port',home:'home',wave:'nature',dot:'service'};
const MAP_MAJOR_PINS=[['E3-STATION','train','תחנת רכבת'],['E3-TERMINAL','bus','מסוף אוטובוסים'],['PLAYER-HOME','home','בית השחקן'],['C2-MALL','bag','קניון'],['D2-HOTEL-1','hotel','המלון הגדול'],['D2-OFFICE-1','office','מגדל המטה'],['B2-LAKE','wave','אגם הפארק'],['D3-DEALER','car','סוכנות רכבים'],['D3-FUEL','fuel','תחנת דלק'],['D3-GARAGE','gear','מוסך'],['D4-DC','box','מרכז הפצה'],['E4-POWER','bolt','תחנת כוח'],['E5-DEPOT','train','חצר רכבות'],['E6-STATION','train','תחנת הנמל'],['E6-BERTH','anchor','רציף עמוק'],['C6-BERTH','anchor','רציף מכולות'],['D6-SERVICE','anchor','מעבורת לאי'],['D5-GATE','anchor','שער הנמל'],['B4-S1','bag','שכונת B4'],['B4-S2','cross','מרפאה'],['B4-S3','school','בית ספר'],['C4-FAB','factory','מפעל C4'],['APT-TERM','plane','שדה תעופה'],['APT-CARGO','box','מטען אווירי'],['APT-HANGARS','gear','האנגרים']];
function mapPinKind(id){
 if(/^APT-/.test(id)){if(/TERM|TOWER|HELI/.test(id))return'plane';if(/CARGO/.test(id))return'box';if(/RENT|PAX|SHORT/.test(id))return'car';if(/FUEL/.test(id))return'fuel';return'gear'}
 if(/^(E6|D6|C6)-/.test(id)){if(/STATION/.test(id))return'train';if(/BERTH|FERRY/.test(id))return'anchor';if(/WORKSHOP|DEPOT/.test(id))return'gear';if(/OFFICE|OPS|CUSTOMS/.test(id))return'office';return'box'}
 if(/HOTEL/.test(id))return'hotel';if(/OFFICE|BANK|POST|CONTROL/.test(id))return'office';if(/PHARMACY|CLINIC|S2$/.test(id))return'cross';
 if(/MALL|SUPER|MINI|MARKET|FISH|CAFE|RESTAURANT|HARDWARE|S1$|KIOSK/.test(id))return'bag';if(/S3$/.test(id))return'school';
 if(/POWER|GRID|SUB$|SOLAR|UTIL|WATER/.test(id))return'bolt';if(/^D5-/.test(id))return'anchor';if(/FUEL/.test(id))return'fuel';if(/GARAGE/.test(id))return'gear';
 if(/TAXI|PARKING|DEALER|IMPORT/.test(id))return'car';if(/STATION|RAIL|SIGNAL|DEPOT$|FREIGHT|STAFF|TERMINAL/.test(id))return'train';if(/HOME/.test(id))return'home';if(/LAKE/.test(id))return'wave';
 if(/WH|DC|DISPATCH|PARCELS|DOCKS|GATE/.test(id))return'box';if(/FAB|WS$/.test(id))return'factory';return'dot'}
let MAP_PINS=null;
function mapPins(){
 if(MAP_PINS)return MAP_PINS;const reg=navPoiRegistry(),out=[],seen=new Set();
 for(const [id,kind,short] of MAP_MAJOR_PINS){const p=reg[id];if(!p)continue;out.push({id,kind,label:short,full:p.label,chunk:p.chunk,x:p.x,y:p.y,major:true});seen.add(id)}
 for(const [id,p] of Object.entries(reg)){if(seen.has(id)||/^(BUS\d|ACT-)/.test(id))continue;out.push({id,kind:mapPinKind(id),label:p.label,full:p.label,chunk:p.chunk,x:p.x,y:p.y,major:false})}
 return MAP_PINS=out}
function mapIcon(c,kind,x,y,r,fill){
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle=fill;c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,r*.2);c.strokeStyle='#0b1218';c.stroke();
 if(kind==='dot'||r<4.5){c.restore();return}
 const u=r*.5;c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.fillStyle='#fff';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,r*.15);c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
 const dots=(y0,dx)=>{for(const d of[-dx,dx]){c.beginPath();c.arc(d,y0,u*.17,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}};
 switch(kind){
  case'train':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-u,1.6*u,1.65*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.8*u,-.25*u);c.lineTo(.8*u,-.25*u);c.stroke();dots(.28*u,.4*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.55*u,1.05*u);c.lineTo(-.9*u,1.4*u);c.moveTo(.55*u,1.05*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,1.4*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'bus':c.strokeRect(-u,-.8*u,2*u,1.55*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,-.1*u);c.stroke();dots(.95*u,.55*u);break;
  case'home':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,0);c.lineTo(0,-.95*u);c.lineTo(u,0);c.stroke();c.strokeRect(-.65*u,0,1.3*u,.95*u);break;
  case'bag':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-.3*u,1.6*u,1.25*u);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-.3*u,.48*u,Math.PI,0);c.stroke();break;
  case'hotel':c.font='800 '+(r*1.25)+'px Arial,sans-serif';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText('H',0,r*.07);break;
  case'office':c.strokeRect(-.55*u,-u,1.1*u,2*u);for(const yy of[-.5,0,.5]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.2*u,yy*u);c.lineTo(.2*u,yy*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'wave':for(const yy of[-.45,.2]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,yy*u);c.quadraticCurveTo(-.5*u,(yy-.45)*u,0,yy*u);c.quadraticCurveTo(.5*u,(yy+.45)*u,u,yy*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'car':c.strokeRect(-u,-.15*u,2*u,.8*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.6*u,-.15*u);c.lineTo(-.3*u,-.75*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.75*u);c.lineTo(.6*u,-.15*u);c.stroke();dots(.75*u,.55*u);break;
  case'fuel':c.strokeRect(-.65*u,-.95*u,1.15*u,1.9*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.4*u,-.5*u);c.lineTo(.25*u,-.5*u);c.moveTo(.5*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,.6*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'gear':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,.5*u,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*.7*u,Math.sin(a)*.7*u);c.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*1.05*u,Math.sin(a)*1.05*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'box':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-.8*u,1.6*u,1.6*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.8*u,0);c.lineTo(.8*u,0);c.moveTo(0,-.8*u);c.lineTo(0,.8*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'factory':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,.85*u);c.lineTo(-u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(-.35*u,-.6*u);c.lineTo(-.35*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.6*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,.85*u);c.closePath();c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.moveTo(.62*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.62*u,-.9*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'bolt':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(.25*u,-u);c.lineTo(-.6*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-.02*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-.25*u,u);c.lineTo(.6*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.02*u,-.2*u);c.closePath();c.fill();break;
  case'anchor':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-.7*u,.25*u,0,Math.PI*2);c.moveTo(0,-.45*u);c.lineTo(0,.85*u);c.moveTo(-.55*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.55*u,-.1*u);c.moveTo(-.85*u,.25*u);c.arc(0,.1*u,.85*u,Math.PI,0,true);c.stroke();break;
  case'cross':c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.27);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-.8*u);c.lineTo(0,.8*u);c.moveTo(-.8*u,0);c.lineTo(.8*u,0);c.stroke();break;
  case'plane':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-1.05*u);c.lineTo(.17*u,-.3*u);c.lineTo(u,.25*u);c.lineTo(.17*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(.12*u,.8*u);c.lineTo(.5*u,1.0*u);c.lineTo(0,.9*u);c.lineTo(-.5*u,1.0*u);c.lineTo(-.12*u,.8*u);c.lineTo(-.17*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-u,.25*u);c.lineTo(-.17*u,-.3*u);c.closePath();c.fill();break;
  case'school':c.strokeRect(-.9*u,-.65*u,1.8*u,1.4*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-.65*u);c.lineTo(0,.75*u);c.stroke();break}
 c.restore()}

function drawMapPins(c,T,o){
 c.save();const W=o.w,H=o.h,icons=[],labels=(o.rects||[]).slice(),rMaj=o.mini?2.3:o.rMaj||9,rMin=o.rMin||6.2,sel=o.sel,vis=[];
 const hit=(list,x,y,w,h)=>{for(const q of list)if(x<q.x+q.w&&x+w>q.x&&y<q.y+q.h&&y+h>q.y)return true;return false};
 for(const p of mapPins()){
  if(!p.major&&!o.minor&&p.id!==sel)continue;
  const x=T.x(p.x),y=T.y(p.y),r=p.major?rMaj:rMin;if(x<-r||y<-r||x>W+r||y>H+r)continue;
  if(!p.major&&p.id!==sel&&(hit(icons,x-r*.8,y-r*.8,r*1.6,r*1.6)||hit(o.rects||[],x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2)))continue;
  icons.push({x:x-r,y:y-r,w:r*2,h:r*2});vis.push({p,x,y,r})}
 for(const {p,x,y,r} of vis){
  const col=MAP_PIN_COLORS[MAP_KIND_CAT[p.kind]||'service'];
  if(p.id===sel){c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+4.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+7.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,138,.65)';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke()}
  if(r>=4.5&&G7_SHOP_BRAND[p.id])g7LogoPin(c,G7_SHOP_BRAND[p.id].b,x,y,r*2.05);else mapIcon(c,p.kind,x,y,r,col);    
  if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:p.id,label:p.full,x,y,r:Math.max(r+5,13)})}
 if(o.labels){const fs=o.fs||11;c.font='600 '+fs+'px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='top';
  for(const {p,x,y,r} of vis){if(!p.major&&p.id!==sel)continue;const t=p.label,tw=c.measureText(t).width+4,lx=x-tw/2,ly=y+r+2;
   if(p.id===sel||(!hit(labels,lx,ly,tw,fs+3)&&!hit(icons.filter(q=>Math.abs(q.x+q.w/2-x)>.5||Math.abs(q.y+q.h/2-y)>.5),lx,ly,tw,fs+3))){labels.push({x:lx,y:ly,w:tw,h:fs+3});mapHaloText(c,t,x,ly,'#f4fbff')}}}
 c.restore()}


function drawBusLineMap(c,T,o={}){
 const lw=o.lw||2.3,off=o.off||2.6,sr=o.stop||3.4;c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
 const paths=BUS_LINES.map(line=>{const route=busRouteForLine(line),k=(line-2)*off,p=new Path2D();for(const seg of route){const e=byEdge[seg.edgeId],A=seg.dirSign>0?byNode[e.a]:byNode[e.b],B=seg.dirSign>0?byNode[e.b]:byNode[e.a],dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y,l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ox=-dy/l*k,oy=dx/l*k;p.moveTo(T.x(A.x)+ox,T.y(A.y)+oy);p.lineTo(T.x(B.x)+ox,T.y(B.y)+oy)}return[line,p]});
 c.strokeStyle='rgba(6,12,18,.8)';c.lineWidth=lw+2.6;for(const [,p] of paths)c.stroke(p);
 for(const [line,p] of paths){c.strokeStyle=BUS_LINE_MAP_COLORS[line];c.lineWidth=lw;c.stroke(p)}
 for(const line of BUS_LINES)for(const st of busStopsForLine(line)){const x=T.x(st.busX),y=T.y(st.busY);c.fillStyle=busLineColor(line);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,sr,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,sr*.35);c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.stroke();if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:st.id,label:st.label,x,y,r:Math.max(sr+5,12)})}
 const tx=T.x(5250),ty=T.y(2130),q=Math.max(4.5,sr+1.4);c.fillStyle='#fff';c.strokeStyle='#17324a';c.lineWidth=1.6;c.beginPath();c.rect(tx-q,ty-q,2*q,2*q);c.fill();c.stroke();
 if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:'BUS1-E3',label:'מסוף האוטובוסים E3',x:tx,y:ty,r:Math.max(q+5,13)});
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES){c.fillStyle=busLineColor(b.line);c.beginPath();c.arc(T.x(b.x),T.y(b.y),sr+.8,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.lineWidth=1.2;c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.stroke()}
 c.restore()}
function drawPlayerMap(c,T,size=5){
 const A=playerActor(),x=T.x(A.x),y=T.y(A.y),a=PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'?PlayerPed.heading:PlayerCar.heading,ph=(performance.now()%1700)/1700;
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,138,'+(.6*(1-ph)).toFixed(3)+')';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,size*(1.6+ph*2.8),0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
 c.rotate(a);c.fillStyle='#ffe08a';c.strokeStyle='#071018';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.5,size*.3);c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(size*1.5,0);c.lineTo(-size,-size*.85);c.lineTo(-size*.45,0);c.lineTo(-size,size*.85);c.closePath();c.stroke();c.fill();c.restore()}

const PHONEMAP={cx:ACTIVE_BOUNDS.x+ACTIVE_BOUNDS.w/2,cy:ACTIVE_BOUNDS.y+ACTIVE_BOUNDS.h/2,s:0,sel:null,layers:{bus:true,poi:true,zones:true},ptrs:new Map(),pinch:0,moved:0,hits:[],w:340,h:310,raf:0};
function pmLimits(){const P=PHONEMAP;return{fit:Math.min((P.w-12)/ACTIVE_BOUNDS.w,(P.h-12)/ACTIVE_BOUNDS.h),min:Math.min((P.w-8)/W80().w,(P.h-8)/W80().h),max:.5}}
function pmClamp(){const P=PHONEMAP,L=pmLimits();if(!P.s)P.s=L.fit;P.s=clamp(P.s,L.min,L.max);const W=W80();P.cx=clamp(P.cx,W.x,W.x+W.w);P.cy=clamp(P.cy,W.y,W.y+W.h)}    
function pmSoon(){const P=PHONEMAP;if(P.raf)return;P.raf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{P.raf=0;drawPhoneMap()})}
function pmZoomAt(f,px,py){const P=PHONEMAP;pmClamp();const wx=P.cx+(px-P.w/2)/P.s,wy=P.cy+(py-P.h/2)/P.s;P.s*=f;pmClamp();P.cx=wx-(px-P.w/2)/P.s;P.cy=wy-(py-P.h/2)/P.s;pmClamp();pmSoon()}
function pmInfoHtml(){
 const id=PHONEMAP.sel,p=id&&navPoiRegistry()[id];
 if(!p)return`<div class="pnote" style="margin:0">גע בסימון במפה לפרטים ולניווט · גרור להזזה · צביטה או גלגלת לזום</div>`;
 const ch=MAP_CHUNKS.find(q=>q.id===p.chunk),on=State.navigation?.targetId===id;

function phoneMap(){

 if(Ly.poi)drawMapPins(c,T,{w:P.w,h:P.h,labels:true,minor:P.s>=.1,sel:P.sel,hits,rMaj:clamp(7.5+P.s*10,8,11),rMin:clamp(5+P.s*8,5.4,8),fs:10.5,rects});
 if(Ly.zones)drawMapZones(c,T,{w:P.w,h:P.h,pass:'labels'});

 P.hits=hits;

  function fishAt(g, id, cm, mx, my, ang, ppc, si, v, t) { sync(); if (typeof TurboCity === 'undefined' || !TurboCity.get(id)) return; const sp = LAKE_FISH.concat(COAST_FISH).find(q => q.id === id); if (!sp) return;
    const sz = si == null ? 2 : si, scale = ppc * cm / (sp.base * FZ[sz]), I = TurboCity.info(id, { scale }), c = I.an.find(a => a[0] === 'Center') || ['C', I.w / 2, I.h / 2];
    g.save(); g.translate(mx, my); g.rotate(ang); TurboCity.draw(g, id, -cm * ppc / 2 - c[1], -c[2], { mode: 'runtime', scale, v: v == null ? 3 : v, sz, time: t || 0 }); g.restore() }
  function fish(g, id, cm, x, y, ang, ppc, top, si, v) { const Ld = cm * ppc; return fishAt(g, id, cm, x + Math.cos(ang) * Ld / 2, y + Math.sin(ang) * Ld / 2, ang, ppc, si, v == null ? (top ? 0 : 3) : v, 0) }
  
  function fitsLv(lv, id) { const rod = RODS[(lv | 0) - 1]; if (!rod) return true; const b = (typeof LAKE_BAITS !== 'undefined' && LAKE_BAITS[id]) || (typeof COAST_BAITS !== 'undefined' && COAST_BAITS[id]) || {};
    if (b.lure || b.reusable || /^lure-/.test(id)) return rod.kind === 'spin' || rod.kind === 'surf'; if (typeof LAKE_BAITS !== 'undefined' && LAKE_BAITS[id]) return rod.baits.includes(id); return rod.kind !== 'spin' }
  
  function bucket(g, x, y, rows, res, night, col) { sync(); const R = .16 * S * PXM, H = .34 * S * PXM * K, c = col || '#2f73b8';
    g.save(); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x + 1, y + .6, R * 1.1, R * .55, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(x - R, 0, x + R, 0); gr.addColorStop(0, shade(c, 1.15)); gr.addColorStop(1, shade(c, .7)); g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - R, y - H); g.lineTo(x - R * .86, y); g.ellipse(x, y, R * .86, R * .43, 0, Math.PI, 0, true); g.lineTo(x + R, y - H); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = shade(c, .55); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H, R, R * .5, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = night ? '#24445c' : '#7fb3c9'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H + .25, R * .88, R * .42, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();   
    g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H + .25, R * .88, R * .42, 0, 0, TAU); g.clip();
    (rows || []).forEach((q, i) => { const a = (i * 2.3) + .6, rr = R * (.12 + .08 * (i % 3)), ppc = S * PXM / 100; fish(g, q.id, q.cm, x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y - H + .25 + Math.sin(a) * rr * .5, a + Math.PI / 2, ppc, true, q.si, 1) });   
    g.restore();
    g.strokeStyle = '#c9d1d8'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.15, .6 / res); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H, R, R * .5, 0, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.95, true); g.stroke();   
    g.restore() }
  function tackleBox(g, x, y, res) { sync(); const w = .42 * S * PXM, d = .24 * S * PXM, h = .2 * S * PXM * K; g.save();
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + .6, y - d / 2 + .8, w, d);
    g.fillStyle = '#3c6b46'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - d / 2 - h, w, h + d * .1); g.fillStyle = '#4f8a5c'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - d / 2 - h - d * .5, w, d * .5);
    g.fillStyle = '#d8b13a'; g.fillRect(x - .5, y - d / 2 - h * .6, 1, h * .35); g.fillStyle = '#2a2d31'; g.fillRect(x - w * .2, y - d / 2 - h - d * .5 - .5, w * .4, .5); g.restore() }
  
  const ST = { wait: 0, bite: 1, fight: 2, lift: 3, keep: 4, release: 5, lost: 6 };
  function anglerNew(seed, rodLv, bait, hasBucket) { return { r: rng(seed), rodLv, bait, hasBucket, st: 'wait', t: 0, next: 0, fish: null, bucket: [], log: [] } }
  function anglerStep(A_, dt, pick, now) {   
    const R = A_.r; A_.t += dt; if (!A_.next) A_.next = 20 + R() * 60;
    if (A_.st === 'wait' && A_.t >= A_.next) { A_.st = 'bite'; A_.t = 0; A_.dur = .7 + R() * .9; A_.fish = pick(A_.rodLv, A_.bait, R) }
    else if (A_.st === 'bite' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.st = 'fight'; A_.t = 0; A_.dur = 1.6 + (A_.fish.si + 1) * 1.1 + R() * 1.5; A_.escapes = R() < .18 }
    else if (A_.st === 'fight' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.t = 0; if (A_.escapes) { A_.st = 'lost'; A_.dur = 2; A_.log.push([now, 'lost', A_.fish]) } else { A_.st = 'lift'; A_.dur = 1.3 } }
    else if (A_.st === 'lift' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.t = 0; A_.dur = 1.6; const small = A_.fish.si === 0 && R() < .5, full = A_.bucket.length >= 6;
      if (A_.hasBucket && !small && !full) { A_.st = 'keep'; A_.bucket.push(A_.fish); A_.log.push([now, 'keep', A_.fish]) } else { A_.st = 'release'; A_.log.push([now, 'release', A_.fish]) } }
    else if ((A_.st === 'keep' || A_.st === 'release' || A_.st === 'lost') && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.st = 'wait'; A_.t = 0; A_.fish = null; A_.next = 30 + R() * 150 }
    return A_ }
  
  function anglerFrame(A_, rod, t) { const s = A_.st;
    if (s === 'wait') return { fr: rod.kind === 'spin' ? (Math.floor(t * 2) % 2 ? 5 : 4) : 0, bend: null, bite: false };
    if (s === 'bite') return { fr: 3, bend: .25 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 9)) * .25, bite: true, bell: true };
    if (s === 'fight') return { fr: Math.floor(t * 2.4) % 2 ? 5 : 4, bend: .4 + Math.sin(t * 5) * .1, bite: true };
    if (s === 'lift') return { fr: 6, bend: .5, fishUp: true };
    return { fr: 7, bend: 0, inHand: s !== 'lost' } }
  return { KINDS, A, F, fitsLv, rng, shade, P, rodSide, reelSide, rodWorld, float, fish, bucket, tackleBox, armsFor, kindOf, dirOf, anglerNew, anglerStep, anglerFrame, fishAt, rest, restGeo, S, K, PXM };
})();

var TC_LIVE_ADD={on:!/[?&#]liveadd=0\b/.test(String(location.href)),base:{regions:ACTIVE_REGIONS.length,ids:MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.size},zones:[],walk:[],err:[]};
function tcLiveAdd(id,o){o=o||{};const L=TC_LIVE_ADD,mode=o.mode||'zone';if(!L.on)return null;
 try{const had=L.zones.concat(L.walk).find(z=>z.id===id);if(had)return had;
  if(mode==='zone'){const q=MAP_CHUNKS.find(c=>c.id===id);if(!q){L.err.push(id+': אין תא כזה ב-MAP_CHUNKS');return null}

  (gen.length?`<div class="plSecT">${type==='fishing'?'חכות, פיתיונות ורישיון':type==='mall'?'כל המוצרים של הקניון':'המדפים'}</div><div class="plGrid">${gen.map(([pid,it])=>tile(pid,it,false)).join('')}</div>`:'')+`</div>`}

var TCSND=(function(){
 const st={ctx:null,master:null,comp:null,ana:null,rev:null,noise:null,lfo:null,vol:.8,mute:false,notes:0,sfx:0,ambOn:0,err:null,created:0,S:null,sessions:0};
 try{const q=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tcShowAudio')||'{}');if(isFinite(q.v))st.vol=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,+q.v));st.mute=!!q.m}catch(e){}
 const keep=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('tcShowAudio',JSON.stringify({v:st.vol,m:st.mute}))}catch(e){}};
 const mtof=m=>440*Math.pow(2,(m-69)/12),R=Math.random;
 function masterLevel(){return st.mute?0:Math.pow(st.vol,1.6)*.95}
  
 function makeIR(ctx,sec,decay){const n=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec),b=ctx.createBuffer(2,n,ctx.sampleRate);for(let ch=0;ch<2;ch++){const d=b.getChannelData(ch);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=i/n;d[i]=(R()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-t,decay)*(t<.012?0:1)}for(const [ms,g] of [[11,.5],[19,.35],[27,.3],[41,.22]]){const i=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*ms/1000*(ch?1.07:1));if(i<n)d[i]+=g*(ch?-1:1)}}return b}
 function ensure(){if(st.ctx)return st.ctx;const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC){st.err='no-audio';return null}
  try{const ctx=new AC({latencyHint:'playback'});st.ctx=ctx;st.created=Date.now();
   st.master=ctx.createGain();st.master.gain.value=masterLevel();st.comp=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();st.comp.threshold.value=-16;st.comp.knee.value=12;st.comp.ratio.value=3.2;st.comp.attack.value=.008;st.comp.release.value=.28;
   const tone=ctx.createBiquadFilter();tone.type='peaking';tone.frequency.value=3200;tone.Q.value=.8;tone.gain.value=-3.5;    
   st.comp.connect(tone);tone.connect(st.master);st.master.connect(ctx.destination);st.ana=ctx.createAnalyser();st.ana.fftSize=2048;st.master.connect(st.ana);
   st.rev=ctx.createConvolver();st.rev.buffer=makeIR(ctx,2.8,3.2);const rg=ctx.createGain();rg.gain.value=.55;st.rev.connect(rg);rg.connect(st.comp);
   const n=ctx.sampleRate*3,nb=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),d=nb.getChannelData(0);let b0=0,b1=0,b2=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const w=R()*2-1;b0=.99765*b0+w*.099;b1=.963*b1+w*.2965;b2=.57*b2+w*1.0526;d[i]=(b0+b1+b2+w*.1848)*.16}st.noise=nb;    
   const wb=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),wd=wb.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)wd[i]=R()*2-1;st.white=wb;
   st.lfo=ctx.createOscillator();st.lfo.frequency.value=5.3;st.vib=ctx.createGain();st.vib.gain.value=7;st.lfo.connect(st.vib);st.lfo.start();
   return ctx}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e);st.ctx=null;return null}}
  
 function session(){const ctx=st.ctx;if(!ctx)return null;const g=ctx.createGain();g.gain.value=1;g.connect(st.comp);const S={g,mus:ctx.createGain(),amb:ctx.createGain(),sfx:ctx.createGain(),send:ctx.createGain(),ambs:{},alive:true};
  S.mus.gain.value=.62;S.amb.gain.value=.5;S.sfx.gain.value=.75;S.send.gain.value=1;S.mus.connect(g);S.amb.connect(g);S.sfx.connect(g);
  S.musRev=ctx.createGain();S.musRev.gain.value=.42;S.mus.connect(S.musRev);S.musRev.connect(S.send);S.sfxRev=ctx.createGain();S.sfxRev.gain.value=.22;S.sfx.connect(S.sfxRev);S.sfxRev.connect(S.send);S.send.connect(st.rev);
  st.sessions++;return S}
 function endSession(S){if(!S||!S.alive)return;S.alive=false;const ctx=st.ctx,t=ctx.currentTime;try{S.g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);S.g.gain.setValueAtTime(S.g.gain.value,t);S.g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.18)}catch(e){}
  setTimeout(()=>{try{S.g.disconnect();S.send.disconnect()}catch(e){}for(const k in S.ambs){try{S.ambs[k].stop()}catch(e){}}},420)}
  
 function osc(type,f,t,end,dest,det){const o=st.ctx.createOscillator();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);if(det)o.detune.setValueAtTime(det,t);o.connect(dest);o.start(t);o.stop(end);return o}
 function gainEnv(dest,t,a,peak,hold,rel,sus){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak,t+a);if(sus!=null)g.gain.setTargetAtTime(peak*sus,t+a,.25);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+Math.max(a,hold),rel/3.5);g.connect(dest);return g}
 function noiseSrc(t,end,dest,white,rate){const s=st.ctx.createBufferSource();s.buffer=white?st.white:st.noise;s.loop=true;if(rate)s.playbackRate.value=rate;s.connect(dest);s.start(t,R()*2);s.stop(end);return s}
 function filt(type,f,q,dest){const b=st.ctx.createBiquadFilter();b.type=type;b.frequency.value=f;if(q!=null)b.Q.value=q;b.connect(dest);return b}

 const PC={C:0,D:2,E:4,F:5,G:7,A:9,B:11};
 function nm(s){const m=/^([A-G])([#b]?)(-?\d)$/.exec(s);if(!m)return 60;return 12*(+m[3]+1)+PC[m[1]]+(m[2]==='#'?1:m[2]==='b'?-1:0)}
 const QUAL={'':[0,4,7],m:[0,3,7],dim:[0,3,6],aug:[0,4,8],'7':[0,4,7,10],m7:[0,3,7,10],maj7:[0,4,7,11],sus4:[0,5,7],sus2:[0,2,7],add9:[0,4,7,14],m9:[0,3,7,14],'6':[0,4,7,9]};
 function chord(s){const m=/^([A-G])([#b]?)(m7|m9|maj7|m|dim|aug|7|sus4|sus2|add9|6)?(?:\/([A-G])([#b]?))?$/.exec(s);if(!m)return{r:0,iv:[0,4,7],b:0};const r=(PC[m[1]]+(m[2]==='#'?1:m[2]==='b'?-1:0)+12)%12;const b=m[4]?(PC[m[4]]+(m[5]==='#'?1:m[5]==='b'?-1:0)+12)%12:r;return{r,iv:QUAL[m[3]||''],b}}
 function prog(s,cb){return s.trim().split(/\s+/).map(x=>{const [n,len]=x.split(':');return{c:chord(n),beats:len?+len:cb}})}
 function melody(s){let b=0;const out=[];for(const x of s.trim().split(/\s+/)){const [n,len]=x.split(':');const d=+(len||1);if(n!=='r'&&n!=='-')out.push([b,d,nm(n)]);b+=d}return{notes:out,len:b}}
 const near=(pc,lo)=>{let m=lo-((lo%12)+12)%12+pc;if(m<lo)m+=12;return m};
  
 function compose(c,out){const beat=60/c.bpm,P=prog(c.ch||'C',c.cb||4),V=c.v==null?.8:c.v,E=(t,i,m,d,v,o)=>{if(t<c.t1-.02)out.push({t,k:'n',i,m,d:Math.max(.05,Math.min(d,c.t1+(c.tail||.6)-t)),v:v*V*(c.fadeIn&&t<c.t0+c.fadeIn?Math.max(.15,(t-c.t0)/c.fadeIn):1),o:o||{}})};
  let b=0,ci=0;const tb=b=>c.t0+b*beat,span=(c.t1-c.t0)/beat;
  while(b<span){const ch=P[ci%P.length],L=ch.beats,t=tb(b),dur=L*beat,tones=ch.c.iv.map(x=>(ch.c.r+x)%12),root=ch.c.b;
   if(c.pad){const lo=c.padLo||55;const vo=ch.c.iv.slice(0,4).map((x,k)=>near((ch.c.r+x)%12,lo+(k?3:0)));vo.sort((a,b)=>a-b);for(const m of vo)E(t,c.pad,m,dur*.98,c.padV||.55,{a:c.padA||.3,r:.8})}
   if(c.bass){const m=near(root,c.bassLo||36);if(c.bass==='timp')E(t,'timp',m,1,.7);else if(c.bass==='walk'){for(let k=0;k<L;k++)E(tb(b+k),'pizz',k%2?m+7:m,beat*.9,.8)}else E(t,c.bass,m,dur*.97,.7)}
   if(c.timp&&(ci%(c.timpEvery||1)===0))E(t,'timp',near(root,40),1,c.timp===2?.95:.65);
   if(c.arp){const r=c.arpR||.5,pat=c.arpPat||'up',lo=c.arpLo||60,ns=[...tones.map(p=>near(p,lo)),near(tones[0],lo)+12],seq=pat==='updown'?[...ns,...ns.slice(1,-1).reverse()]:pat==='broken'?[ns[0],ns[2],ns[1],ns[3]||ns[0]+12]:ns;for(let k=0;k*r<L-.001;k++)E(tb(b+k*r),c.arp,seq[k%seq.length],r*beat*(c.arp==='harp'||c.arp==='piano'?3:1),(c.arpV||.5)*(k%2?.85:1))}
   if(c.pulse){const r=c.pulseR||.5;for(let k=0;k*r<L-.001;k++){const m=near(root,c.pulseLo||43)+(c.pulseOct&&k%2?12:0);E(tb(b+k*r),c.pulse,m,r*beat*.7,(c.pulseV||.55)*(k%(1/r*2)===0?1.15:1),{a:.02,r:.12})}}
   if(c.drums){const D=c.drums;for(let k=0;k<L;k++){const tt=tb(b+k);if(D==='march'){E(tt,'snare',0,.1,k%2?.35:.55);if(k%2)E(tt+beat/2,'snare',0,.1,.3);if(k===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.6)}
     else if(D==='train'){E(tt,'brush',0,.1,.55);E(tt+beat/2,'brush',0,.1,.35);if(k%2===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.35)}
     else if(D==='soft'){if(k===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.4);E(tt+beat/2,'hat',0,.1,.3)}
     else if(D==='build'){for(let q=0;q<4;q++)E(tt+q*beat/4,'snare',0,.06,.12+.5*((b+k+q/4)/span))}
     else if(D==='dance'){if(k%2===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.5);else E(tt,'snare',0,.1,.4);E(tt+beat/2,'hat',0,.1,.3)}}}
   b+=L;ci++}
  for(const key of ['mel','mel2','mel3']){const M=c[key];if(!M)continue;const ml=melody(M.s),o=(M.o||0)*12,start=M.from||0;let base=start;while(base<span){for(const [nb,nd,m] of ml.notes){const bb=base+nb;if(bb>=span)break;E(tb(bb),M.i,m+o,nd*beat*(M.leg||.96),M.v||.7,{p:M.p});if(M.dbl)E(tb(bb),M.dbl,m+o+(M.dblO||0)*12,nd*beat*.96,M.dblV||.4)}if(!M.loop)break;base+=ml.len}}
  if(c.end==='swell')out.push({t:c.t1-1.6,k:'n',i:'swell',m:0,d:1.6,v:.8*V,o:{}});
  if(c.end==='hit'){out.push({t:c.t1-.05,k:'n',i:'cym',m:0,d:2.4,v:.7*V,o:{}});out.push({t:c.t1-.05,k:'n',i:'timp',m:near(P[0].c.r,40),d:1,v:.9*V,o:{}})}
  if(c.startCym)out.push({t:c.t0,k:'n',i:'cym',m:0,d:2.6,v:.6*V,o:{}});
  if(c.roll){for(let tt=c.t1-c.roll;tt<c.t1;tt+=.075)out.push({t:tt,k:'n',i:'timp',m:near(P[0].c.r,40),d:.3,v:.25+.6*((tt-(c.t1-c.roll))/c.roll),o:{}})}
  return out}
  
 function build(spec){const ev=[];for(const c of spec.cues||[])compose(c,ev);for(const s of spec.sfx||[])ev.push({t:s[0],k:'s',s:s[1],v:s[2]==null?.8:s[2],p:s[3]});for(const a of spec.amb||[])ev.push({t:a[0],k:'a',a:a[1],v:a[2],f:a[3]||1.5});for(const n of spec.notes||[])ev.push({t:n[0],k:'n',i:n[1],m:typeof n[2]==='string'?nm(n[2]):n[2],d:n[3]||1,v:n[4]||.7,o:n[5]||{}});ev.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);return ev}
 function fire(S,e,at){try{if(e.k==='n'){const f=INST[e.i];if(f){f(at,e.m,e.d,e.v,S.mus,e.o||{});st.notes++}}else if(e.k==='s'){const f=SFX[e.s];if(f){f(S,at,e.v,e.p);st.sfx++}}else if(e.k==='a')amb(S,e.a,e.v,e.f,at)}catch(x){st.err=String(x&&x.message||x)}}
  
 function play(spec){const ctx=ensure();const P={ev:build(spec),i:0,S:null,synced:false,pump,pause,resume,stop,count:0};
  function start(showT){if(!st.ctx||P.S)return;P.S=session();st.S=P.S;const lv={};let i=0;while(i<P.ev.length&&P.ev[i].t<showT-.05){const e=P.ev[i];if(e.k==='a')lv[e.a]=e;i++}P.i=i;for(const k in lv){const e=lv[k];amb(P.S,e.a,e.v,.5)}}
  function pump(showT){if(P.done||!st.ctx)return;if(st.ctx.state==='suspended'&&!P.paused){try{st.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}}if(st.ctx.state!=='running')return;if(!P.S)start(showT);const S=P.S;if(!S||!S.alive)return;const now=st.ctx.currentTime;
   while(P.i<P.ev.length&&P.ev[P.i].t<showT+.32){const e=P.ev[P.i++];if(e.t<showT-.12&&e.k!=='a')continue;fire(S,e,now+Math.max(0,e.t-showT)+.02);P.count++}}
  function pause(){P.paused=true;try{st.ctx&&st.ctx.suspend()}catch(e){}}
  function resume(){P.paused=false;try{st.ctx&&st.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}}
  function stop(){P.done=true;const S=P.S;if(S)endSession(S);if(st.S===S)st.S=null;P.S=null;setTimeout(()=>{try{if(st.ctx&&!st.S&&st.ctx.state==='running')st.ctx.suspend()}catch(e){}},520)}
  return P}
 function setVol(v){st.vol=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));if(st.master)st.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(masterLevel(),st.ctx.currentTime,.05);keep()}
 function setMute(m){st.mute=!!m;if(st.master)st.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(masterLevel(),st.ctx.currentTime,.03);keep()}
  
 function duck(on){const S=st.S;if(!S||!S.alive||!st.ctx)return;const t=st.ctx.currentTime;S.mus.gain.setTargetAtTime(on?.24:.62,t,on?.08:.35);S.amb.gain.setTargetAtTime(on?.3:.5,t,on?.08:.35);st.ducked=!!on}
 function level(){if(!st.ana)return 0;const a=new Float32Array(st.ana.fftSize);st.ana.getFloatTimeDomainData(a);let s=0;for(const x of a)s+=x*x;return Math.sqrt(s/a.length)}
 return{st,ensure,play,setVol,setMute,level,duck,nm,melody,chord,build,INST,SFX,AMB,get ctx(){return st.ctx},get vol(){return st.vol},get mute(){return st.mute}}})();


var TCK=(function(){
 const TAU=Math.PI*2,cl=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v,lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,sm=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)},seg=(t,a,b)=>cl((t-a)/(b-a),0,1),eio=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u<.5?4*u*u*u:1-Math.pow(-2*u+2,3)/2};
 const HX={};function hx(h){if(HX[h])return HX[h];let s=String(h).replace('#','');if(s.length===3)s=s.split('').map(q=>q+q).join('');const n=parseInt(s.slice(0,6),16)||0;return HX[h]=[n>>16&255,n>>8&255,n&255]}
 function mix(a,b,u){const A=hx(a),B=hx(b);u=cl(u,0,1);return'#'+A.map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(B[i]-v)*u).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
 function rgba(h,a){const A=hx(h);return'rgba('+A[0]+','+A[1]+','+A[2]+','+cl(a,0,1).toFixed(3)+')'}
 function rng(seed){let s=(seed>>>0)||1;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296}}
  
 function kf(keys,t,ease){ease=ease||sm;if(t<=keys[0][0])return keys[0].slice(1);for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1];if(t<b[0]){const u=ease((t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]));return a.slice(1).map((v,j)=>typeof v==='string'?mix(v,b[j+1],u):lerp(v,b[j+1],u))}}return keys[keys.length-1].slice(1)}
  
 function walker(keys,stride){stride=stride||46;const segs=[];let acc=0;for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1],d=Math.hypot(b[1]-a[1],(b[2]||0)-(a[2]||0));segs.push({a,b,d,acc});acc+=d}
  return t=>{if(t<=keys[0][0])return{x:keys[0][1],y:keys[0][2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:0};for(const q of segs){if(t<q.b[0]){const u0=(t-q.a[0])/(q.b[0]-q.a[0]),u=lerp(u0,sm(u0),.55),x=lerp(q.a[1],q.b[1],u),y=lerp(q.a[2]||0,q.b[2]||0,u);return{x,y,moving:q.d>1?1:0,dir:Math.sign(q.b[1]-q.a[1]),ph:(q.acc+q.d*u)/stride}}}const L=keys[keys.length-1];return{x:L[1],y:L[2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:acc/stride}}}
 const cache={};function cached(key,w,h,fn){let cv=cache[key];if(!cv){cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(w));cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(h));fn(cv.getContext('2d'),cv.width,cv.height);cache[key]=cv}return cv}
  
 const SKY=[[0,'#03061a','#0a1436','#1a2652'],[4.6,'#070c2a','#1e2350','#3e3566'],[5.6,'#1d2a5e','#6a5a8c','#f0a07a'],[6.6,'#3d6fb0','#9ec1de','#ffd7a0'],[8.5,'#3a86d6','#86bfea','#d6ecf8'],[16,'#3a82d0','#8cc2ea','#e0eef6'],[17.6,'#3a64a8','#d79a72','#ffd08a'],[18.6,'#2a3c78','#c0607a','#ff9a5a'],[19.4,'#141c48','#55406e','#d0705c'],[20.4,'#070d2c','#18224a','#363a62'],[24,'#03061a','#0a1436','#1a2652']];
 const STORM=['#15191f','#252b35','#39414d'];
 function skyCols(h,storm){h=((h%24)+24)%24;let a=SKY[0],b=SKY[1];for(let i=0;i<SKY.length-1;i++)if(h>=SKY[i][0]&&h<=SKY[i+1][0]){a=SKY[i];b=SKY[i+1];break}const u=sm((h-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]||1));let r=[1,2,3].map(j=>mix(a[j],b[j],u));if(storm)r=r.map((q,j)=>mix(q,STORM[j],storm));return r}
 function sky(c,x,y,w,h,hour,storm){const C=skyCols(hour,storm),g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);g.addColorStop(0,C[0]);g.addColorStop(.55,C[1]);g.addColorStop(1,C[2]);c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h);return C}
 function dark(hour){const h=((hour%24)+24)%24;return h<5?1:h<7?1-(h-5)/2:h<17.5?0:h<20.5?(h-17.5)/3:1}
 function glow(c,x,y,r,col,a){if(a<=0||r<=0)return;const g=c.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,rgba(col,a));g.addColorStop(.35,rgba(col,a*.45));g.addColorStop(1,rgba(col,0));c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2)}
 function sun(c,x,y,r,hour){const low=cl(1-Math.abs(((hour||12)-12))/6.5,0,1),col=mix('#ff7a3a','#fff3c4',low);glow(c,x,y,r*7,mix('#ff9a4a','#fff0b0',low),.45);glow(c,x,y,r*2.4,col,.8);c.fillStyle=mix(col,'#ffffff',.35);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill()}
 function moon(c,x,y,r,a){a=a==null?1:a;glow(c,x,y,r*6,'#c8d8ff',.22*a);c.fillStyle=rgba('#f2efe0',a);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=rgba('#c9c4b0',.5*a);for(const [dx,dy,rr] of [[-.3,-.2,.22],[.25,.15,.16],[.05,.42,.12],[.4,-.35,.1]]){c.beginPath();c.arc(x+dx*r,y+dy*r,rr*r,0,TAU);c.fill()}}
 function stars(c,x,y,w,h,t,a,seed){if(a<=.02)return;const r=rng(seed||7),n=Math.round(w*h/2600);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sx=x+r()*w,sy=y+r()*h*(r()<.7?.6:1),b=r(),tw=.6+.4*Math.sin(t*(1+b*3)+i);c.fillStyle=rgba('#ffffff',a*(.3+.7*b)*tw*(1-(sy-y)/h*.6));const z=b>.93?2.2:b>.7?1.5:1;c.fillRect(sx,sy,z,z)}}
  
 function cloudCanvas(seed,col,shade){return cached('cl|'+seed+'|'+col+'|'+shade,360,170,(g,w,h)=>{const r=rng(seed);const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<11;i++){const u=i/10;pts.push([40+u*280+(r()-.5)*30,110-Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*(30+r()*40)-r()*12,26+Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*34+r()*14])}
  for(const [px,py,pr] of pts){const gr=g.createRadialGradient(px,py-pr*.3,pr*.1,px,py,pr);gr.addColorStop(0,col);gr.addColorStop(.7,mix(col,shade,.35));gr.addColorStop(1,rgba(mix(col,shade,.6),0));g.fillStyle=gr;g.beginPath();g.arc(px,py,pr,0,TAU);g.fill()}

 function clouds(c,t,o){ const r=rng(o.seed||3);for(let i=0;i<o.n;i++){const sp=(o.sp||8)*(.6+r()*.8),s=(o.s||1)*(.6+r()*.7),span=o.w+500*s,x=o.x-250*s+(((r()*span+t*sp)%span)+span)%span,y=o.y+r()*(o.dy||60);cloud(c,x,y,s,(o.seed||3)*31+i%5,o.col||'#ffffff',o.shade||'#9aa7b8',o.a==null?.95:o.a)}}
  
 function sea(c,x,y,w,h,t,o){o=o||{};const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);g.addColorStop(0,o.top||'#2a6f97');g.addColorStop(1,o.bot||'#0b3d5c');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h);

 function waveBand(c,x0,x1,y,amp,len,ph,col,depth){c.fillStyle=col;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y+depth);for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x+=8)c.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x/len+ph)*amp+Math.sin(x/(len*.43)+ph*1.7)*amp*.3);c.lineTo(x1,y+depth);c.closePath();c.fill()}

 function rain(c,t,x,y,w,h,n,ang,a){c.strokeStyle=rgba('#cfe0f0',a==null?.35:a);c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();const r=rng(99),len=16+h*.02,dx=Math.sin(ang||.2)*len,dy=Math.cos(ang||.2)*len;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sx=r()*w,sy=r()*h,sp=.8+r()*.6,yy=y+((sy+t*h*1.6*sp)%h),xx=x+((sx+t*w*.1*Math.sin(ang||.2)*sp)%w+w)%w;c.moveTo(xx,yy);c.lineTo(xx+dx,yy+dy)}c.stroke()}

 function flash(t,times){let f=0;for(const q of times){const d=t-q;if(d>=0&&d<.9)f=Math.max(f,d<.08?1:d<.16?.3:d<.24?.85:Math.max(0,1-(d-.24)/.6)*.5)}return f}

 const EXPR={n:[.1,.05,'n',1],smile:[.35,.15,'smile',1],grin:[.55,.25,'grin',.92],laugh:[.75,.4,'laugh',.3],sur:[1.5,1.3,'o',1.38],worry:[1.2,-.5,'worry',1.06],sad:[1.1,-.7,'frown',.9],det:[-.9,.35,'det',.86],think:[.9,-.2,'side',.95],shout:[.3,.9,'shout',1.2],proud:[.2,.4,'smile',.8],calm:[0,0,'smile',.62]};
 function ik(ax,ay,bx,by,l1,l2,sg){let dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);const mx=l1+l2-.02;if(d>mx){bx=ax+dx/d*mx;by=ay+dy/d*mx;dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;d=mx}if(d<.01)d=.01;const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx),A=Math.acos(cl((l1*l1+d*d-l2*l2)/(2*l1*d),-1,1)),q=a+sg*A;return[ax+Math.cos(q)*l1,ay+Math.sin(q)*l1,bx,by]}
 function limb(c,x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2,w1,w2,c1,c2){c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.strokeStyle=c1;c.lineWidth=w1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y0);c.lineTo(x1,y1);c.stroke();c.strokeStyle=c2||c1;c.lineWidth=w2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x1,y1);c.lineTo(x2,y2);c.stroke()}
  
 function armTargets(P,B,T){const pr=P.arms||'down',d=P.turn>=0?1:-1,sy=B.sy,ph=P.walk!=null?P.walk*TAU:0,sw=P.walk!=null?Math.sin(ph)*(P.run?9:5):0,o={};
  const down=[[-B.sw-2.2-sw*.2,sy+30],[B.sw+2.2+sw*.2,sy+30]];
  const set=(a,b)=>{o.a=a;o.b=b};
  switch(typeof pr==='string'?pr:'custom'){
   case'down':set([down[0][0]+sw*(P.turn||0),down[0][1]],[down[1][0]-sw*(P.turn||0),down[1][1]]);break;
   case'hips':set([-B.sw-6,sy+24],[B.sw+6,sy+24]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'wave':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set(down[0],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'wave2':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set([-B.sw-12-w,sy-26],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'up':set([-B.sw-6,sy-34],[B.sw+6,sy-34]);break;
   case'cheer':{const w=Math.sin(T*7)*4;set([-B.sw-9+w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)],[B.sw+9-w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)]);break}
   case'point':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-28,sy+2],d>0?[B.sw+28,sy+2]:down[1]);break;
   case'pointUp':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-12,sy-30],d>0?[B.sw+12,sy-30]:down[1]);break;
   case'chin':set(d>0?down[0]:[-2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9],d>0?[2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9]:down[1]);break;
   case'head':set([-B.sw+1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7],[B.sw-1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7]);break;
   case'clap':{const op=Math.abs(Math.sin(T*11))*5;set([-1.5-op,sy+15],[1.5+op,sy+15]);break}
   case'front':set([-5,sy+19],[5,sy+19]);break;
   case'hold':set([d*6-5,sy+16],[d*6+5,sy+16]);break;
   case'lantern':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-10,sy+14],d>0?[B.sw+10,sy+14]:down[1]);break;
   case'pull':{const k=Math.sin(T*3)*3;set([d*(16+k)-3,sy+20],[d*(26+k)+3,sy+17]);break}
   case'shrug':set([-B.sw-9,sy+9],[B.sw+9,sy+9]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'think':set(down[0],[3,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.95]);break;
   case'shade':set(down[0],[d*3+2,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.35]);break;
   case'crank':{const a=T*4.2;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*5-2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5],[d*14+Math.cos(a)*5+2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5]);break}
   case'wheel':{const a=Math.sin(T*1.6)*.5;set([d*16+Math.cos(Math.PI+a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(Math.PI+a)*8],[d*16+Math.cos(a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(a)*8]);break}
   case'radio':set(d>0?down[0]:[-4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8],d>0?[4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8]:down[1]);break;
   case'bow':set([-4,sy+34],[4,sy+34]);break;
   case'shake':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-16,sy+20],d>0?[B.sw+16,sy+20+Math.sin(T*10)*2]:down[1]);break;
   case'give':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-18,sy+10],d>0?[B.sw+18,sy+10]:down[1]);break;
   case'row':{const a=T*3;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3],[d*20+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3]);break}
   default:set(pr.a||down[0],pr.b||down[1]);o.bend=pr.bend}
  return o}
  
 function fig(c,x,y,s,L,P){P=P||{};const boy=!!L.boy,B=boy?BOY:MAN,T=P.t||0,turn=cl(P.turn||0,-1,1),at=Math.abs(turn),d=turn>=0?1:-1;
  c.save();c.translate(x,y);const k=s*(L.h||(boy?.8:1));c.scale(k,k*(P.sy||1));if(P.lean)c.rotate(P.lean);
  const walking=P.walk!=null,ph=walking?P.walk*TAU:0,bob=walking?-Math.abs(Math.sin(ph))*(P.run?3.2:1.7):0,yb=(P.bob||0)+bob+(P.legs==='sit'?B.th*.92:P.legs==='kneel'?B.sh*.7:0);
  const top=L.tc||'#4a6a8a',dk=mix(top,'#000000',.32),skin=L.skin||'#d9a07a',skinD=mix(skin,'#3a2010',.28),pc=L.pc||'#2e3440',pcD=mix(pc,'#000000',.3),shoe=L.shoe||'#2a1f18';
  if(P.shadow!==false){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.28)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,15,3.2,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
   
  const hipY=B.hip+yb,legW=B.limb[2],shW=B.limb[3],long=L.pants!=='shorts';const legs=[];
  for(const i of [0,1]){const hx0=(i?1:-1)*B.hw*.48*(1-at*.3),side=i?1:-1;let fx,fy,kn=d;
   if(P.legs==='sit'){const kx=hx0+d*B.th*Math.max(.3,at)*.95;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+2,kx+d*1.5,0]);continue}
   if(P.legs==='kneel'){if(i===(d>0?0:1)){legs.push([hx0,hipY,hx0+d*2,hipY+B.th*.95,hx0-d*B.sh*.7,-1])}else{const kx=hx0+d*B.th*.75;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+B.th*.35,kx,0])}continue}
   if(walking){const sw=(P.run?.8:.4)*Math.sin(ph+(i?Math.PI:0)),lift=Math.max(0,Math.cos(ph+(i?Math.PI:0)))*(P.run?8:4.5);fx=hx0+sw*B.th*(.25+at*.95)*d*(at>.15?1:.25);fy=-lift}
   else{const sp=P.legs==='spread'?7:P.legs==='brace'?(i?9:-9)*d:0;fx=hx0*1.15+sp*side*(P.legs==='spread'?1:0)+(P.legs==='brace'?sp:0);fy=0}
   const j=ik(hx0,hipY,fx,fy,B.th,B.sh,(i?-1:1)*-d*.0+(-d));legs.push([hx0,hipY,j[0],j[1],fx,fy])}
  const order=turn>0?[0,1]:[1,0];

 function cinema(c,W,H,S,dpr){const F=S.prod,T=S.t,ft=T-PRE,E=PRE+F.len,house=T<PRE?1-K.sm(T/2.6)*.94:T>E?.06+K.sm((T-E-1)/2.5)*.9:.06,cur=T<PRE?K.sm((T-1.8)/2.6):T>E?1-K.sm((T-E-1.2)/2.8):1;

  const hq=Math.round(house*20)/20,bg=K.cached('hall|'+W+'x'+H+'|'+hq+'|'+dpr,W*dpr,H*dpr,(g)=>{g.scale(dpr,dpr);const wall=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);wall.addColorStop(0,K.mix('#0e0a14','#3a2430',hq));wall.addColorStop(1,K.mix('#040306','#24141c',hq));g.fillStyle=wall;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   for(const s of [-1,1]){const x0=s<0?0:W,pw=Math.max(0,(W-sw)/2-14);if(pw<20)continue;for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const px=s<0?x0+pw*(k+.5)/3:x0-pw*(k+.5)/3,py=sy+sh*.35;g.strokeStyle=K.rgba('#c9a24a',.25+hq*.4);g.lineWidth=1.5;g.strokeRect(px-pw/7,sy+10,pw/3.5,H*.62);
    g.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#d9b45a',hq);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(px-9,py);g.lineTo(px+9,py);g.lineTo(px+5,py+16);g.lineTo(px-5,py+16);g.closePath();g.fill();K.glow(g,px,py+4,70*(.3+hq),'#ffcf8a',.15+hq*.55);K.glow(g,px,py-30,90,'#ffcf8a',hq*.18)}}
   for(const x of [W*.04,W*.96]){if(W<700)break;g.fillStyle='#0d3b1f';g.fillRect(x-30,H*.5,60,20);K.text(g,'יציאה',x,H*.5+10,13,'#6bff9a',{w:700,glow:'#2aff6a',gb:8})}
   g.fillStyle='#030204';g.fillRect(sx-14,sy-12,sw+28,sh+24)});
  c.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);const sc=S.scr,lum=S.lum*(ft>0&&ft<F.len?1:0);if(lum>.02){c.fillStyle=K.rgba(sc,.07*lum);c.fillRect(sx-40,sy-30,sw+80,sh+60)}
   
  c.save();c.translate(sx,sy);c.scale(sw/FW,sh/FH);c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,FW,FH);c.clip();filmFrame(c,F,ft,S);
  if(ft>0&&ft<F.len){const g=c.createRadialGradient(FW/2,FH/2,FH*.42,FW/2,FH/2,FW*.62);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.42)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}c.restore();
  if(T<PRE+.4){c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#d6cdbd',house*.65);c.fillRect(sx,sy,sw,sh)}
  if(S.frame%30===0&&ft>0&&ft<F.len){try{const sm=buf(S,'smp',6,2),g=sm.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});g.drawImage(c.canvas,sx*dpr,sy*dpr,sw*dpr,sh*dpr,0,0,6,2);const d=g.getImageData(0,0,6,2).data;let r=0,gg=0,b=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){r+=d[i];gg+=d[i+1];b+=d[i+2]}const n=d.length/4;r/=n;gg/=n;b/=n;S.lum=(r*.3+gg*.59+b*.11)/255;const m=Math.max(r,gg,b,1);S.scr='#'+[r,gg,b].map(v=>Math.round(Math.min(255,v/m*230)).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}catch(e){}}
   
  if(ft>0&&ft<F.len){c.save();const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,H,0,sy+sh);g.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(sc,0));g.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(sc,.05+lum*.07));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(W/2-30,H+40);c.lineTo(W/2+30,H+40);c.lineTo(sx+sw,sy+sh);c.lineTo(sx,sy+sh);c.closePath();c.fill();const R=K.rng(4);for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const u=(R()+T*.01*(R()+.2))%1,px=K.lerp(W/2,sx+R()*sw,u),py=K.lerp(H,sy+sh,u)+Math.sin(T*.6+i)*6;c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#ffffff',.18*R()*(.3+lum));c.fillRect(px,py,1.5,1.5)}c.restore()}
   
  curtainPair(c,sx-14,sy-12,sw+28,sh+24,cur,house,T);
   
  const laugh=ft>0?env(F.react&&F.react.laugh,ft):0,lean=ft>0?env(F.react&&F.react.lean,ft):0,clap=T>E+.1&&T<E+4.6?1:0;
  c.save();c.translate(0,0);K.crowd(c,W,H+20,{rows:3,rowH:H*.085,n:Math.max(7,Math.round(W/120)),scale:Math.max(.7,Math.min(1.5,H/620)),t:T,lit:sc,la:.2+lum*.55,laugh,lean,clap,clapHigh:1,seat:'#2a0710',seed:9,dim:(1-house)*.72});c.restore();
  if(S.snack){c.save();c.translate(W-90,H-10);popcorn(c,1.1*Math.min(1.4,H/620),K.rgba(sc,.4))}
}
 function popcorn(c,s,lit){c.scale(s,s);c.fillStyle='#f4f0e6';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-34,-110);c.lineTo(34,-110);c.lineTo(26,0);c.lineTo(-26,0);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle='#c0392b';for(let i=0;i<4;i++){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-34+i*17+4,-110);c.lineTo(-34+i*17+12,-110);c.lineTo(-26+i*13+9,0);c.lineTo(-26+i*13+3,0);c.closePath();c.fill()}const R=K.rng(3);for(let i=0;i<26;i++){c.fillStyle=i%3?'#fff3c8':'#f7d98a';c.beginPath();c.arc(-30+R()*60,-112-R()*18,6+R()*3,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}c.strokeStyle=lit;c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-34,-110);c.lineTo(-26,0);c.stroke();c.restore()}
 function curtainTex(w,h,col){return K.cached('cur|'+Math.round(w)+'|'+Math.round(h)+'|'+col,w,h,(g,W,H)=>{const n=Math.max(8,Math.round(W/34));for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=i*W/n,gr=g.createLinearGradient(x,0,x+W/n,0);gr.addColorStop(0,K.mix(col,'#000000',.55));gr.addColorStop(.45,K.mix(col,'#ffffff',.08));gr.addColorStop(.6,col);gr.addColorStop(1,K.mix(col,'#000000',.55));g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x,0,W/n+1,H)}const v=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);v.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.35)');v.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');v.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.25)');g.fillStyle=v;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.fillStyle='#d9a93b';for(let x=0;x<W;x+=7)g.fillRect(x,H-10,3.5,10);g.fillStyle='#b8861e';g.fillRect(0,H-12,W,3)})}
 function curtainPair(c,x,y,w,h,open,house,T){const half=w/2,cw=half*(1-open*.94),tex=curtainTex(half,h,'#7a1426'),sway=Math.sin(T*.8)*2*(open>0&&open<1?3:1);
  if(cw>2){for(const s of [-1,1]){c.save();c.beginPath();if(s<0)c.rect(x,y,cw+sway,h);else c.rect(x+w-cw-sway,y,cw+sway,h);c.clip();c.drawImage(tex,s<0?x-(half-cw)+sway:x+w-cw-sway,y,half,h);c.restore()}
   K.glow(c,x+w/2,y+h,h*.9,'#ffb070',.12+house*.25)}
  const vh=Math.max(18,h*.09);c.fillStyle='#5a0d1c';c.fillRect(x-10,y-vh*.6,w+20,vh);c.fillStyle='#7a1426';for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const sx2=x-10+(w+20)*i/14,sw2=(w+20)/14;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(sx2,y+vh*.4);c.quadraticCurveTo(sx2+sw2/2,y+vh*1.2,sx2+sw2,y+vh*.4);c.fill()}c.fillStyle='#d9a93b';c.fillRect(x-10,y+vh*.35,w+20,2.5)}
  
 function theatre(c,W,H,S,dpr){const P=S.prod,T=S.t,Kf=(k,d)=>k?K.kf(k,T)[0]:d,house=Kf(P.house,.08),cur=Kf(P.curtain,1),stage=Kf(P.stage,1),bpm=P.bpm||90;
  const pw=Math.min(W*.8,H*.6*SW/SH),ph=pw*SH/SW,px=(W-pw)/2,py=Math.max(H*.12,46);
   
  const wall=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);wall.addColorStop(0,K.mix('#1a0a10','#5a1c26',house));wall.addColorStop(1,K.mix('#0a0406','#2a0c12',house));c.fillStyle=wall;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  K.glow(c,W/2,py+ph*.6,Math.max(W,H)*.6,'#ffcf8a',.05+stage*.12);
  for(const s of [-1,1]){const bx=s<0?px*.5:W-px*.5,bw=px*.78;if(bw<40)continue;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const by=py+ph*(.18+k*.42),bh=ph*.3;c.fillStyle=K.mix('#2a0a12','#6a1e2a',house*.6+stage*.2);c.fillRect(bx-bw/2,by,bw,bh);c.fillStyle='#c9a24a';c.fillRect(bx-bw/2,by+bh-8,bw,4);
    const R=K.rng(k*7+(s>0?3:1));for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const hx2=bx-bw/2+bw*(i+.5)/3,hy=by+bh-16,sc2=bw/150;c.fillStyle='#120a0c';c.beginPath();c.arc(hx2,hy-6*sc2,7*sc2,0,K.TAU);c.fill();c.fillRect(hx2-10*sc2,hy,20*sc2,10*sc2);c.strokeStyle=K.rgba('#ffcf8a',.25*stage);c.lineWidth=1.5;c.beginPath();c.arc(hx2,hy-6*sc2,7*sc2,Math.PI*1.1,Math.PI*1.6);c.stroke()}
    c.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#ffe0a0',house);c.beginPath();c.arc(bx,by-10,4,0,K.TAU);c.fill();K.glow(c,bx,by-10,40,'#ffcf8a',house*.6)}}
  for(const x of [W*.18,W*.82]){K.glow(c,x,H*.05,120,'#ffe6b0',house*.55);c.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#fff0c8',house);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){c.beginPath();c.arc(x-30+i*10,H*.04+Math.abs(i-3)*3,2.4,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}}
   
  c.save();c.translate(px,py);c.scale(pw/SW,ph/SH);c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,SW,SH);c.clip();c.fillStyle='#050305';c.fillRect(0,0,SW,SH);
  S.spots=[];try{P.draw(c,T,S)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,300)}
  c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-stage)+')';c.fillRect(0,0,SW,SH);
  c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';for(const q of S.spots){const a=(q.a==null?.5:q.a)*stage;if(a<=0)continue;const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,q.y);g.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',a*.05));g.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',a*.22));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q.x+(q.sx||0)-14,-10);c.lineTo(q.x+(q.sx||0)+14,-10);c.lineTo(q.x+q.r,q.y);c.lineTo(q.x-q.r,q.y);c.closePath();c.fill();const e=c.createRadialGradient(q.x,q.y,2,q.x,q.y,q.r*1.2);e.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',a*.5));e.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(q.col||'#fff2d0',0));c.fillStyle=e;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q.x,q.y,q.r*1.2,q.r*.28,0,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}c.restore();
   
  if(cur<.995){const ch=SH*(1-cur),tex=curtainTex(SW,SH,'#8a1830');c.drawImage(tex,0,ch-SH,SW,SH);c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.25)';c.fillRect(0,ch-6,SW,6);if(P.onCurtain)P.onCurtain(c,T,ch,S)}
  c.restore();
   
  c.save();c.strokeStyle='#b8862e';c.lineWidth=Math.max(6,pw*.012);c.strokeRect(px-c.lineWidth/2,py-c.lineWidth/2,pw+c.lineWidth,ph+c.lineWidth);c.strokeStyle='#e9c46a';c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(px-pw*.016,py-pw*.016,pw+pw*.032,ph+pw*.032);
  const vh=ph*.08;c.fillStyle='#6a1022';c.fillRect(px-pw*.02,py-vh*.3,pw*1.04,vh);c.fillStyle='#8a1830';for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const x0=px-pw*.02+pw*1.04*i/12,w0=pw*1.04/12;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,py+vh*.6);c.quadraticCurveTo(x0+w0/2,py+vh*1.25,x0+w0,py+vh*.6);c.fill()}c.fillStyle='#e0b24a';c.fillRect(px-pw*.02,py+vh*.55,pw*1.04,2.5);
  c.fillStyle='#d9a93b';c.beginPath();c.arc(W/2,py-vh*.3,Math.max(10,pw*.022),Math.PI,0);c.fill();c.restore();
   
  const fy=py+ph;c.fillStyle='#1a1008';c.fillRect(px-10,fy,pw+20,Math.max(8,H*.014));for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const x=px+pw*(i+.5)/16;K.glow(c,x,fy+3,22,'#ffd68a',.35*stage);c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#ffe6b0',.4+stage*.6);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,fy+4,2.2,0,K.TAU);c.fill()}
  const pitY=fy+Math.max(10,H*.016),pitH=Math.max(30,H*.07);c.fillStyle='#07040a';c.fillRect(px-20,pitY,pw+40,pitH);const beat=T*bpm/60,R=K.rng(21),nm=Math.max(8,Math.round(pw/60));
  for(let i=0;i<nm;i++){const x=px+pw*(i+.5)/nm,y=pitY+pitH*.62,s2=pitH/60;K.glow(c,x+6*s2,y+8*s2,18*s2,'#ffd68a',.5);c.fillStyle='#ffe6b0';c.fillRect(x,y+6*s2,14*s2,3*s2);c.fillStyle='#0d0a0e';c.beginPath();c.arc(x-6*s2,y-6*s2,7*s2,0,K.TAU);c.fill();c.fillRect(x-14*s2,y,16*s2,16*s2);
   if(R()<.6){const bw2=Math.sin(beat*Math.PI+i)*6*s2;c.strokeStyle=K.rgba('#d9c8a0',.6);c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-18*s2+bw2,y-6*s2);c.lineTo(x+2*s2+bw2,y+2*s2);c.stroke()}}
  {const x=W/2,y=pitY+pitH*.45,s2=pitH/55,b=Math.sin(beat*Math.PI)*.6;c.fillStyle='#0d0a0e';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y-10*s2,8*s2,0,K.TAU);c.fill();c.fillRect(x-9*s2,y-3*s2,18*s2,22*s2);c.strokeStyle='#efe6d0';c.lineWidth=1.5;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x+8*s2,y);c.lineTo(x+8*s2+Math.cos(-1.1+b)*18*s2,y+Math.sin(-1.1+b)*18*s2);c.stroke()}
   
  const ln=lineNow(S,T),sub=ln?[0,0,ln.text,ln.b?'b':'']:null;const by=Math.max(4,py-vh*.3-Math.max(34,H*.055)-6),bh=Math.max(30,H*.05);c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.72)';c.fillRect(W/2-pw*.42,by,pw*.84,bh);c.strokeStyle='rgba(242,196,90,.3)';c.strokeRect(W/2-pw*.42,by,pw*.84,bh);
  const SZ=typeof TCSET!=='undefined'?TCSET.subsScale():1;    
  if(sub&&SZ){const al=Math.max(0,ln.a);c.save();c.globalAlpha=al;K.text(c,sub[2],W/2,by+bh/2,Math.min(26,bh*.62)*SZ,sub[3]==='b'?'#ffe9a8':'#ffd27a',{w:700});c.restore()}
   
  const laugh=env(P.react&&P.react.laugh,T),lean=env(P.react&&P.react.lean,T),clap=P.clap?(P.clap.some(([a,b])=>T>=a&&T<b)?1:0):0,stand=P.stand?K.kf(P.stand,T)[0]:0;
  K.crowd(c,W,H+16,{rows:3,rowH:H*.08,n:Math.max(7,Math.round(W/115)),scale:Math.max(.7,Math.min(1.5,H/620)),t:T,lit:'#ffcf8a',la:.15+stage*.4+house*.3,laugh,lean,clap,clapHigh:1,stand,seat:'#3a0a14',seed:12,dim:(1-house)*.6});
}
  
 function spot(S,x,y,r,col,a,sx){S.spots.push({x,y,r,col,a,sx})}
  
 function poster(cv,kind,i){const p=(kind==='film'?FILMS:PLAYS)[i];if(!p||!cv)return;const d=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),w=cv.clientWidth||240,h=cv.clientHeight||340;cv.width=Math.round(w*d);cv.height=Math.round(h*d);const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);
  try{c.save();if(kind==='film'){const sh=p.shots[p.posterShot||1],sc=h/FH;c.translate(w/2-(p.posterX||FW/2)*sc,0);c.scale(sc,sc);sh.draw(c,p.posterT||1,(p.posterT||1)/sh.d)}else{const sc=h/SH*1.15;c.translate(w/2-(p.posterX||SW/2)*sc,-SH*.08*sc);c.scale(sc,sc);const fake={spots:[],poster:1};p.draw(c,p.posterT||20,fake)}c.restore()}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.message||e)}
  const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,h*.55,0,h);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.85)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);const t2=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h*.2);t2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.5)');t2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');c.fillStyle=t2;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h*.2);
  const ts=Math.max(16,Math.min(w*.11,h*.12,46)),ss=Math.max(10,Math.min(w*.05,h*.06,19)),ty=h-ss*1.9-ts*.6;K.text(c,kind==='film'?'אולפני טורבו סיטי מציגים':'התיאטרון העירוני מציג',w/2,Math.max(12,h*.06),Math.max(10,Math.min(w*.045,15)),'#f2e6c8',{w:600});K.text(c,p.name,w/2,ty,ts,'#f6d27a',{stroke:'rgba(0,0,0,.6)',sw:5});if(p.sub)K.text(c,p.sub,w/2,ty+ts*.55+ss*.9,ss,'#f4ecd8',{w:600});
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(242,196,90,.7)';c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(4,4,w-8,h-8);cv.dataset.drawn='1'}

  if(code==='KeyF'||k==='f'||k==='F'||k==='כ'||k==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();close(false);return}
  if(code==='Space'||code==='KeyP'||k==='פ'){e.preventDefault();toggle();wake(S);return}

  if(code==='ArrowUp'||code==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();sndStart();TCSND.setVol(TCSND.vol+(code==='ArrowUp'?.1:-.1));if(TCSND.mute)TCSND.setMute(false);syncUi(S);wake(S);return}
  if(/^(Key|Digit|Arrow|Space|Enter)/.test(code))e.preventDefault()},true);

 function stats(){const a=ST.dts.slice(30).sort((x,y)=>x-y),n=a.length,q=p=>n?a[Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(n*p))]:0,dm=(ST.dms||[]).slice(30).sort((x,y)=>x-y),dq=p=>dm.length?+dm[Math.min(dm.length-1,Math.floor(dm.length*p))].toFixed(1):0;return{drawP50:dq(.5),drawP95:dq(.95),frames:n,p50:+q(.5).toFixed(1),p95:+q(.95).toFixed(1),p99:+q(.99).toFixed(1),max:+(n?a[n-1]:0).toFixed(1),over33:a.filter(x=>x>33.4).length,over50:a.filter(x=>x>50).length}}

var TCFA=(function(){const K=TCK,TAU=Math.PI*2,FW=1280,FH=540;

var TCVOICE=(function(){
 const st={sent:0,started:0,ended:0,errors:0,cancels:0,voices:0,he:0,last:null,log:[]};
 const MALE=/asaf|avri|ronen|david|yossi|אסף|אברי|\bmale\b|standard-b|standard-d|wavenet-b|wavenet-d|neural2-b|neural2-d/i,FEMALE=/carmit|hila|michal|כרמית|הילה|מיכל|female|standard-a|standard-c|wavenet-a|wavenet-c|neural2-a|neural2-c/i;
 let he=[];
 function load(){try{if(!window.speechSynthesis)return;const all=speechSynthesis.getVoices()||[];st.voices=all.length;he=all.filter(v=>/^he|^iw/i.test(v.lang||'')||/hebrew|עברית/i.test(v.name||''));st.he=he.length}catch(e){}}
 try{if(window.speechSynthesis){load();speechSynthesis.addEventListener?speechSynthesis.addEventListener('voiceschanged',load):(speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=load)}}catch(e){}
 const ok=()=>{if(!he.length)load();return !!(window.speechSynthesis&&typeof SpeechSynthesisUtterance==='function'&&he.length)};
 const hash=s=>{let h=7;for(const ch of String(s))h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return h};
  
 function voiceOf(who,role){const males=he.filter(v=>MALE.test(v.name)&&!FEMALE.test(v.name)),neutral=he.filter(v=>!FEMALE.test(v.name)),pool=males.length?males:neutral.length?neutral:he,lowered=!males.length,h=hash(who||role||'x'),j=((h>>>4)%5-2)*.04;
  

  const local=pool.filter(v=>v.localService),online=pool.filter(v=>!v.localService);let v,pitch,rate;
  if(!lowered&&pool.length>1){if(role==='b'){v=(local[0]||pool[0]);pitch=1.38+j;rate=1.12}else if(role==='o'){v=(online[0]||pool[pool.length-1]);pitch=.86+j/2;rate=.84}else{v=pool[h%pool.length];pitch=1+j;rate=1}}
  else if(!lowered){v=pool[h%pool.length];pitch=role==='b'?1.36+j:role==='o'?.72+j/2:.96+j;rate=role==='o'?.86:role==='b'?1.1:1}
  else{v=pool[h%pool.length];pitch=role==='b'?.95+j:role==='o'?.42+j/2:.55+j;rate=role==='o'?.88:role==='b'?1.08:1}
  return{v,pitch:Math.max(.1,Math.min(2,pitch)),rate}}
  
 function speak(text,who,role,vol,cb){if(!ok())return false;try{const q=voiceOf(who,role),rate=q.rate*(cb&&cb.rate||1),V=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,vol));
   

   const parts=String(text).length>150?String(text).split(/(?<=[.!?…:;])\s+/).reduce((a,s)=>{if(a.length&&(a[a.length-1]+' '+s).length<=150)a[a.length-1]+=' '+s;else a.push(s);return a},[]):[String(text)];
   let k=0,done=false;const fin=e=>{if(done)return;done=true;st.ended++;cb&&cb.onend&&cb.onend(e)};
   const one=()=>{const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(parts[k]);u.lang='he-IL';try{if(q.v)u.voice=q.v}catch(e){}u.pitch=q.pitch;u.rate=rate;u.volume=V;
     if(k===0)u.onstart=()=>{st.started++;cb&&cb.onstart&&cb.onstart()};
     u.onend=()=>{k++;if(k<parts.length&&!done)one();else fin()};u.onerror=e=>{st.errors++;fin(e)};speechSynthesis.speak(u)};
   one();st.sent++;st.last=text;if(st.log.length<300)st.log.push([+(cb&&cb.t||0).toFixed(2),who||'',String(text).length,q.v&&q.v.name||'',+q.pitch.toFixed(2),parts.length]);return true}catch(e){st.errors++;return false}}

 function pause(){try{window.speechSynthesis&&speechSynthesis.pause()}catch(e){}}
 function resume(){try{window.speechSynthesis&&speechSynthesis.resume()}catch(e){}}
 function reset(){st.sent=st.started=st.ended=st.errors=0;st.log=[]}

var TCCITY=(function(){
 const st={n:0,ms:0,max:0,err:null,warm:0};

   render(SIM_LOOP.renderNow+(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined'?SIM_BENCH_OFS:0))}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,200)}
  finally{if(ap)try{simInterpRestore()}catch(e){}C.x=sx;C.y=sy;C.zoom=sz;State.mapQa=sq;window.__TC_NIGHT=sn}
  const ms=performance.now()-t0;st.n++;st.ms+=(ms-st.ms)*.1;st.max=Math.max(st.max,ms);return g}

 const ok=()=>typeof render==='function'&&!!document.getElementById('game');
